title: License Owner / Operator, Oman
description:
Build the Future of Football in Oman

What if your passion for football could become something you lead, grow, and make your own?

Stranger Soccer is expanding into new cities around the world and is looking for a License Owner / Operator to bring the Stranger Soccer experience to Oman.

This isn't a traditional management position. It's an opportunity to build, own, and grow a local football operation while becoming part of an established international brand. We're looking for entrepreneurial individuals who are passionate about football and driven to create a meaningful impact in their local community.

Imagine Being the Person Who...

● Brings football players together through a seamless mobile platform

● Builds a vibrant football community in Oman

● Creates memorable playing experiences week after week

● Leads a growing local operation backed by proven technology and global expertise

What You'll Do

As the License Owner / Operator, you'll oversee every aspect of Stranger Soccer, including:

● Growing the local player community

● Securing football venues and partnerships

● Recruiting and managing Official Hosts

● Leading marketing and community-building initiatives

● Delivering consistently outstanding game experiences

You'll have the independence to grow your local operation while receiving ongoing support, technology, and operational guidance from our Singapore headquarters.

Why Stranger Soccer?

Stranger Soccer makes playing football as simple as booking a gym session. Through our mobile app, players can discover games, reserve a spot, and simply turn up to play.

Founded in Singapore, Stranger Soccer now operates in 10+ cities worldwide and has delivered more than 100,000 games. Our proven model is built for growth—and we're ready to bring it to Oman.

Who We're Looking For

● A football enthusiast with strong local insight

● An entrepreneurial self-starter who enjoys taking ownership

● A leader who can build relationships and grow a local community

● Someone looking for more than a job—someone who wants to create lasting impact

Ready to Take the Lead?

Visit and explore "Bring Stranger Soccer to Your City" to learn more and express your interest.

Help shape the future of football in Oman—and build something you'll be proud of.

title: Business Intelligence Analyst - Data and Automation
description:
SHAPING THE FUTURE THROUGH INNOVATION AND DISCOVERY!

With a history spanning more than seven decades, Communications & Power Industries’ thousands of products have impacted people’s lives in numerous unseen ways every day. Our highly engineered products serve as the backbone of modern-day commercial and military communications systems, assist in diagnosing medical conditions, empower scientific discoveries and space exploration, and much more.

CPI is headquartered in Plano, Texas and is a global manufacturer of electronic components and subsystems. We have manufacturing locations in the United States, Canada, Europe, and Asia. With a heritage of technological excellence, our team serves customers in the communications, defense, medical, industrial, and scientific markets.

YOUR DAY TO DAY:

We are looking for a Business Intelligence Analyst – Data and Automation to join our CPI Power Electronics team. This is a hands-on role responsible for turning business needs and data from JD Edwards, Salesforce, and other sources into reliable reporting, actionable analysis, and practical process improvements. The position independently extracts, combines, validates, and automates data, building solutions using SQL, Power BI, advanced Excel, and Python.

Reporting to the Business Process Improvement Manager, you will work with functional teams and local and corporate IT to establish priorities, define meaningful performance measures, and deliver maintainable solutions. The role combines technical development with business analysis, helping users understand results, make informed decisions, and reduce recurring manual effort.

YOU WILL BE ACCOUNTABLE FOR/TO:

Business Requirements & Stakeholder Coordination

  • Confirm business questions, priorities, metric definitions, and acceptance criteria with stakeholders and translate them into practical data and reporting requirements.

  • Work with functional teams to understand business processes, identify reporting needs, and prioritize opportunities for analysis and automation.

  • Manage agreed priorities, communicate progress, issues, and dependencies, and follow through on commitments.

Data Extraction, Integration & Quality

  • Independently extract and combine data from JD Edwards, Salesforce, databases, spreadsheets, and other approved sources using SQL, supported connectors, APIs, and scripts as appropriate.

  • Validate and reconcile results to source systems, ensuring reporting outputs are accurate, consistent, and traceable.

  • Document calculations and transformations, establish repeatable data-quality checks, and resolve discrepancies with business owners and IT.

Reporting & Dashboard Development

  • Build and maintain Power BI semantic models, DAX measures, Power Query transformations, and dashboards that clearly communicate performance and exceptions.

  • Develop advanced Excel analyses that combine and reconcile data from multiple sources.

  • Maintain scheduled refreshes and troubleshoot reporting discrepancies to support reliable, timely access to information.

Automation & Process Improvement

  • Automate recurring data preparation, analyses, and reporting using appropriate tools, including Python.

  • Maintain reliable automated processes with error handling, monitoring, and refresh controls within IT-approved environments.

  • Identify opportunities to reduce manual effort, improve consistency, and simplify recurring business processes.

  • Monitor solution accuracy, usefulness, and reductions in manual effort to assess the effectiveness of improvements.

Business Analysis & Decision Support

  • Deliver prioritized analyses of backlog, sales pipeline, inventory and material availability, production and delivery performance, margins, and working capital.

  • Investigate trends, exceptions, and underlying causes; explain findings and recommend practical actions.

  • Present results clearly to technical and nontechnical audiences and help users apply insights to business decisions.

Solution Delivery & Governance

  • Test solutions with users against agreed requirements and acceptance criteria.

  • Document and version-control code, reporting logic, and supporting procedures to ensure solutions remain maintainable.

  • Train and support users in understanding reports, using analytical tools, and applying results.

  • Coordinate with local and corporate IT on access, credentials, security, and infrastructure.

  • Share reusable solutions and collaborate with State College and other CPI analysts to support consistent practices and knowledge sharing.

YOU ARE THE RIGHT PERSON FOR THIS JOB IF YOU HAVE:

  • A bachelor’s degree in Business Analytics, Information Systems, Computer Science, Industrial Engineering, Finance, Business, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.

  • At least three years of relevant experience in business intelligence, data analysis, business analysis, operations analytics, or process automation, including hands-on development of reporting or analytical solutions.

  • Demonstrated delivery of solutions that independently extract, combine, validate, and automate data from multiple systems to support a business decision or improve a recurring process.

  • Demonstrated SQL proficiency, including joins, aggregations, common table expressions or subqueries, and validation queries to retrieve and reconcile relational data.

  • Hands-on proficiency with Power BI, including Power Query, data modeling, DAX measures, dashboard development, scheduled refresh, and troubleshooting reporting discrepancies.

  • Advanced Excel skills, including PivotTables, lookup and aggregation formulas, Power Query, and repeatable analyses that reconcile data from multiple sources.

  • Practical experience with Python and APIs, including writing, modifying, troubleshooting, and maintaining scripts to extract, clean, combine, and validate data, while handling common data formats, authentication requirements, and errors.

  • Strong business analysis and data-quality skills, with the ability to define useful measures, understand processes, trace results to their sources, identify root causes, and translate findings into recommendations.

  • Strong written and verbal communication, documentation, organization, and follow-through, with the ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities.

  • Ability and willingness to travel less than 10% to the United States, primarily State College, Pennsylvania, for support, collaboration, training, and workshops, and to meet applicable international travel requirements.

  • Direct experience with JD Edwards and Salesforce data, reporting, or interfaces is preferred.

  • Experience in manufacturing or engineered-product businesses, including analysis of orders, backlog, inventory, production, margins, or working capital, is preferred.

  • Experience with Git or other source control, scheduled jobs, Power Automate, or other data integration and workflow automation tools is an asset.

  • Experience applying Lean or other process improvement methods, or approved AI tools, to reduce manual effort while protecting company data and validating results is an asset.

WHO WE ARE:

We value the unique and diverse skills, qualities, and backgrounds that each employee brings to CPI, and we respect each employee as an integral member of our growing team. CPI is committed to providing equal employment opportunities for all current and prospective employees, as well as to promoting a culture of inclusion and respect for everyone. We celebrate the innovation that diversity creates in the work environment, and we recognize that each employee brings their own unique capabilities, experiences, and perspectives to the organization. It is this variety that adds value to our teams, as well as to our stakeholders. We welcome and encourage applicants to reach their full potential with us.

CPI is proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, sexual stereotypes, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

WHAT WE OFFER:

Whether you are a seasoned professional or just embarking on your career, CPI is an ideal place to expand your knowledge and expertise. We cultivate a healthy, dynamic, and team-oriented environment that empowers our employees to develop, create and deliver innovative, reliable technology solutions to power, connect, protect, and support a better tomorrow.

We offer our employees an attractive compensation package with competitive salaries and comprehensive benefits, including health and wellness programs, career development, generous retirement savings plan with company match and more!

We do not use artificial intelligence to screen, assess or select applicants.

  • Salary: $86,000 CAD annually, based on relevant experience and qualifications.

title: Senior Registrar, Exhibitions
location: Long Island City, New York, United States
description:
About MoMA PS1

Inspired by daring artists, MoMA PS1 is committed to the exploration of contemporary art and culture, broadening perspectives on the issues of our day, and engaging New Yorkers and communities across the world. Founded in 1976, the institution was a defining force in the alternative space movement in New York City, transforming a nineteenth-century public schoolhouse in Long Island City into a site for artistic experimentation and creativity. PS1 has been a member of New York City’s Cultural Institutions Group (CIG) since 1982 and aﬃliated with The Museum of Modern Art since 2000.

We recognize that a successful candidate will meet many of the requirements listed on this job description but may not meet 100% of the qualifications. If much of this job description describes you, we encourage you to apply for this role.

Summary

MoMA PS1 seeks an experienced Senior Registrar to lead registration logistics for our ambitious contemporary exhibition program. The Senior Registrar will partner directly with curatorial staff, living artists, international and domestic lenders and vendors to oversee packing, shipping, couriers, insurance, condition reports, installation, and ongoing maintenance for temporary exhibition artworks, site-specific installations, and loans. Additionally, this role implements policies and procedures to support the exhibition program and uphold museum best practices.

Supervision

This position reports to the Director of Exhibitions and Programs and works collaboratively across all museum departments including Program Production, Curatorial, External Affairs, Visitor Engagement, Security, Operations, and Administration, as well as with lenders, conservators, artists, couriers, and other artistic collaborators. The Senior Registrar leads a dedicated team including one Registrar and one Assistant Registrar as well as regularly scheduled contract Registrars. In collaboration with the Manager of Installation and Production, the Senior Registrar guides a team of seasonal gallery installation staff.

Responsibilities

  • Direct end-to-end registration logistics for all incoming loans, temporary exhibitions and site-specific commissions, including domestic and international art shipping, crating, packing, and customs clearances in compliance with museum standards.
  • Develop and oversee registration budgets by creating initial estimates, processing and tracking expenses, and reporting regularly on budgets related to each exhibition.
  • Administer loan agreements, negotiating lender terms and requirements in close coordination with the Director of Exhibitions and Programs, the Chief Curator and Director of Curatorial Affairs, MoMA Legal, and insurance broker.
  • Manage fine art insurance coverage, including policy renewal, special exhibition coverage, COI procurement, and ongoing broker relations.
  • Plan all install and deinstall schedules in collaboration with the Program Production team; consider staffing levels for art handler needs, contract registrar assignments, artists on-site, couriers, conservators, shipping deadlines and curatorial priorities.
  • Partner directly with curators, living artists, lenders, fabricators and conservators to establish care, handling, and installation protocols for all incoming loans including unconventional materials and site-specific works.
  • Manage incoming and outgoing condition reports, maintain archival photographic records, and coordinate daily gallery checks.
  • Work across museum departments to supervise ongoing artwork maintenance, environmental monitoring, and safety in gallery spaces throughout the run of each exhibition.
  • Implement and update registration policies, digital record keeping standards, and workflow procedures to uphold museum best practices.

Qualifications

  • Minimum of 7 years of registration experience, including logistical oversight of art handling, packing, domestic and international shipping, customs clearance, and courier transit for complex exhibitions.
  • Thorough knowledge of standard museum loan and registration practices and fine arts insurance.
  • Demonstrated experience developing and managing registration budgets.
  • Experience directing and managing skilled installation crews, with creative problem-solving skills for non-standard galleries and a wide range of artistic media.
  • Strong interpersonal, written, and verbal communication skills, including diplomatic negotiation and cross-departmental collaboration.
  • Proven ability to prioritize, multitask, and meet evolving deadlines with composure in a fast-paced environment.
  • Flexibility to respond to emergencies and art incidents during off-hours, weekends, and holidays.
  • Proficient with museum databases systems (TMS preferred) and experience working in Google environments.

Compensation and Benefits

The salary range for this position is $80,000 – $95,000 annually. Benefits include 20 days paid vacation leave; 10 days paid sick leave; 11 paid holidays; and 3 paid personal days; participation in a 401(k) savings plans, life insurance; medical/health (including visual and dental); transit, health, and dependent care FSA; and pension plan.

MoMA PS1 is an equal opportunity employer committed to a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace.

We recognize that a successful candidate may not meet 100% of the qualifications listed. If much of this description describes you, we encourage you to apply.

title: Senior Full Stack Developer (React.js, Python)
location: Washington, District of Columbia, United States
description:
About Peregrine

Peregrine Advisors is a rapidly growing AI and data innovation hub helping government solve hard problems and deliver better outcomes. We work across the full lifecycle—from strategy and governance through architecture, engineering, analytics, AI, visualization, and training—for clients including the SEC, PCAOB, DDOT, and DCAA.

Our clients describe our support as “absolutely excellent” and our people as “instrumental to organization’s success.” Winner of the United Nations COP27 Datathon, our work has earned all Exceptional CPARS ratings, SEC Chair’s Awards, the SEC Vision Award, and recognition from FDA leadership.

We are also built differently. Peregrine is the first and only social enterprise organized as a Benefit Corporation and SBA 8(a) company focused on AI and data for government. We believe business success should create client value, social value, and opportunity for our people.

As we enter our next stage of growth, we need dependable, motivated, and skilled people who have a combination of intellectual curiosity and intellectual courage. With new clients, larger programs, and expanding responsibilities, the people joining Peregrine now will have the opportunity to help shape the company we become.

People first. Ownership always.

We solve problems through people, process, and technology—in that order. Technology matters, but people make transformation happen. That principle defines our culture. Trust and motivation are the foundational pillars of delivery on which our skills stand. We hire people we can trust, who care deeply about what they do, take ownership, learn quickly, help one another, and refuse to walk past a problem because it belongs to someone else.

At Peregrine, you are not joining simply to fill a position. You are joining a team, taking ownership of a mission, and helping build a company. If that excites you, we should talk.

At Peregrine Advisors, you will take cloud-native Python services from refinement through production on Amazon Web Services (AWS), retaining ownership of each service's design and delivery throughout. But we hire people, not seats. As the work evolves, you will move to where the hardest problems are.

This is a hybrid work arrangement based in the Washington, DC metropolitan area, and the commuting cadence varies by assignment. The initial engagement requires United States citizenship and the ability to obtain a Public Trust determination.

Your first project

Expect your first project to make you the one who decides how a solution's components fit together, and the one who carries it through production. Depending on the assignment, you may:

  • For your portion of the platform, design Python services and application components and carry them through delivery.
  • Produce the design of the React.js front end where users do their work, and define the standards other developers follow when they build it.
  • Determine how your services connect to the wider platform by designing their data flows, integrations, and application programming interfaces (APIs).
  • Use Amazon Relational Database Service (RDS), Amazon Simple Storage Service (S3), Amazon Simple Queue Service (SQS), and AWS Lambda to create automated workflows.
  • Make application security standards, code reviews, and test-driven development part of the quality development practices you lead.
  • Create and improve your team's automated tests, the continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipelines it uses for releases, and the practices it uses to support production.
  • Mentor fellow developers, conduct code reviews, work through difficult production problems, and settle design tradeoffs.
  • Estimate projects accurately, and play a part in planning them, forecasting delivery, and allocating resources.
  • Make implementation and review faster with AI-assisted development tools, and remain responsible for the code you ship.

You deliver a unified solution in which the components work together and meet the same quality standard. You automate spreadsheet-based validations and workflows, and the developers around you improve because of how you work.

This is where you start, not the shape of your career here.

Requirements

  • 7+ years of professional hands-on back-end software development experience in Python
  • 5+ years of hands-on front-end software development experience in React.js
  • Bachelor's degree
  • A strong practical background developing cloud-native applications on AWS with Amazon RDS, Amazon SQS, Amazon S3, and AWS Lambda
  • An advanced understanding that spans database design, data modeling, object-oriented programming, design patterns, distributed systems, and software architecture
  • A strong background working with relational database systems such as SQL Server, PostgreSQL, or Oracle
  • A strong background using NoSQL databases, for example DynamoDB or MongoDB
  • Strength in analysis, troubleshooting, and solving problems
  • A background directing Agile delivery in Scrum or Kanban, with the work tracked in Jira or a similar issue tracker
  • An established record of directing a team of developers and mentoring them
  • Direct, practical use of AI-assisted developer tools, for example GitHub Copilot or Amazon Q Developer
  • Excellent communication skills that let you engage technical teams, business stakeholders, and executive leaders
  • Proficiency in writing, PowerPoint, and Excel

Preferred

  • A background in putting CI/CD pipelines in place and following DevSecOps best practices
  • Certification in either Python or AWS
  • Prior work in information technology for the federal government
  • Experience heading technical delivery teams on consulting engagements involving direct client interaction

Who you are

You are accountable for what you build and invest time in helping fellow developers improve through code reviews, explanations of your reasoning, and the standard you establish. Others turn to you for difficult decisions because your judgment is sound, and you maintain a steady, productive team as priorities change. You experiment, fail, learn, and repeat quickly. You would rather own an outcome than be handed a task.

What you bring

  • Deep expertise in modern cloud development, broad enough to enhance systems that are already running or to create something new.
  • Judgment to compare competing solutions, resolve design tradeoffs between components, and take ownership of technical direction in the area assigned to you.
  • Strong delivery discipline covering accessibility, secure coding, code review, automated testing, and version control, with the standing to establish these practices for a team.
  • The ability to explain your work in plain terms to those who depend on it, and to listen carefully for their needs.
  • Uncompromising rigor whenever accuracy and auditability are on the line.

You adapt your development workflow as AI tools evolve, using them to help implement, test, and improve the components you own. You give the tools clear context, review and test their output, and remain accountable for the code you deliver.

When we talk

Be prepared to discuss a difficult problem you worked through, the decisions you made, what happened, and what you learned.

Benefits

This is a full-time W-2 position with a salary of $150,000 to $180,000 per year.

Benefits include medical, dental, and vision insurance with the employee premium fully paid and half of dependent premiums; employer-paid life, accidental death, and short-term and long-term disability insurance; a 401(k) with an employer match of up to 4% of salary; unlimited paid time off; and sponsored professional certifications and continuing education.

What we offer

You will work alongside developers, engineers, data scientists, architects, and strategists, on work ranging from strategy to implementation. We support your development across assignments and clients through extensive onboarding, sponsored professional certifications such as the Data Management Capability Assessment Model (DCAM) and AWS technical certifications, and rotation across functions to expand your skills and perspective. The mission is real, the problems are hard, and you own what you ship.

What we commit to

As a Benefit Corporation, our commitment runs three ways: real, measurable value for our clients; government that works better for the public; and a team that makes everyone in it better.

We hire people who want to help build the firm, not just work at it. If that is you, apply.

title: Head of Physical Education and Sport Faculty
description:
Aiglon College seeks to appoint a suitably qualified

Head of Physical Education and Sport Faculty

to join the school from: August 2027

Your profile

The role and candidate profile for this role is detailed in the attached job description and person specification.

Successful Aiglon staff are enthusiastic, experienced, committed, reflective, dynamic and willing to try new ideas. If you share these values and have an appetite for challenge and an ambition to make a positive impact on our world, we welcome your application.

About us

Located in Chesières (Vaud, Switzerland), Aiglon College is a not-for-profit, international boarding school offering a distinctive, world-class education in a stunning alpine setting.

The school was founded on a distinctive ethos: the balanced development of mind, body and spirit. This philosophy underpins everything we do at Aiglon, both inside and outside the classroom.

There are over 480 students, representing more than 70 nationalities, following the International GCSE (IGCSE) and International Baccalaureate Diploma (IB Diploma) programmes.

What we offer

Aiglon is dedicated to the well-being and professional development of all staff, within a vibrant, friendly, and modern workplace. Beyond competitive salaries and comprehensive social security benefits, we provide free accident and loss of salary insurances, generous pension and leave entitlements, as well as a range of special perks and advantages.

How to apply

Deadline for applications: 02.11.2026

Early applications are encouraged. We reserve the right to appoint before the application deadline should we find the right candidate. Please apply through our School platform (eteach) following the instructions; applications sent by standard email will not be considered.

Aiglon is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children.

Applicants will therefore need to undergo child protection screening appropriate to the post.

You can find information on how the School processes your personal data within the School’s Privacy Notice.

JOB PURPOSE

Aiglon College is an international boarding school based in the Swiss Alps with a worldwide reputation for providing a challenging holistic education in an inspiring setting within a safe, caring and supportive framework. The School is CIS accredited, and caters for around 500 students aged 7-18 representing 70 nations. Students prepare for IGCSEs and the IB Diploma Programme.

Teachers are expected to make a significant contribution to the ethos of Aiglon College. The expectation is that staff will be positive and contribute enthusiastically to the life and work of the school. Teachers are directly responsible to the relevant Head of Faculty for the successful management of their classes and for the development and performance of students. The points listed in the job description below identify the key areas of this role; additional responsibilities may arise from time to time at the reasonable request of the School Director.

The ideal candidate for this position would be an experienced, enthusiastic, dynamic, knowledgeable leader and/or teacher of Physical Education and Sport. PE and Sport are compulsory for students throughout the Junior and Senior schools. In Years 10 and 11 students have the option of studying IGCSE PE. Subsequently, in Years 12 and 13, Sports, Exercise and Health Science is offered and is currently taught in conjunction with the Science department.

KEY TASKS AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Professional Standards and Expectations

  • Carry out teaching duties and exercise responsibilities in line with the Guiding Principles of Aiglon;

  • Treat all members of the community, colleagues and students, with respect and consideration. Treat all students fairly, consistently and without prejudice;

  • Set a good example to students in terms of appropriate dress, standards of punctuality and attendance;

  • Read and adhere to the various policies of the school as expressed in the Aiglon Guide and other agreed documentation, and support the ethos of the school by upholding the behaviour code, uniform and kit regulations and other expectations;

  • Be available to work on campus in good time to complete all necessary preparations and meetings before the start of term;

  • Take personal responsibility for professional development and participate in staff training in line with the continued professional development programme of Aiglon;

  • Encourage members of their faculty to take responsibility for their own professional development and ensure all in the faculty participate in staff training in line with the CPD programme of Aiglon;

  • Reflect on personal and school practices in pursuit of continuous improvement.

  • Participate in appraisal and self-evaluation activities and ensure the appraisal system is adhered to and completed within the faculty;

  • Chair a weekly faculty meeting;

  • Ensure all faculty members are aware of and adhere to departmental deadlines, policies and procedures;

  • Undertake pastoral and other duties, including weekend and evening duties, as prescribed within school policies;

  • Ensure that all deadlines are met as published in the school calendar and as directed by the Head of Faculty/Deputy School Directors;

  • Undertake professional duties that may be reasonably assigned, including cover and exam invigilation and ensure members of their faculty also undertake these duties;

  • Attend Assembly/Meditation on at least two mornings a week when averaged over any term and be prepared to give a Meditation once each year;

  • Be proactive and take responsibility for matters relating to health and safety;

  • Support the school through regular attendance at various events in the School Calendar (these may be religious, spiritual, sporting or cultural).

Departmental Management

  • Implement a clear vision for curriculum Physical Education and all aspects of Sport at Aiglon, making sure that there is continuity and progression between Junior School and Senior School;

  • Develop and manage the strategic development plan for the faculty in line with the School’s strategic development plan thus fostering a love of Physical Education and inspiring a lifelong commitment to Sport;

  • Line management of Head of Junior Physical Education and Sport, Head of Senior Physical Education and Sport, Head of Snowsports and Performance Athletes, MCFC football coach and the Sports Facilities Manager and support them in the management of all other members of the Physical Education and Sport faculty;

  • Ensure that the faculty embraces the opportunities available through strategic partnerships including MCFC;

  • Ensure the faculty handbook is updated annually and includes reference to objectives for the year ahead which tie into the school’s overall objectives;

  • Provide a strategic link between the Academic Leadership Group and the Physical Education and Sport faculty, attending meetings and reporting on School-wide initiatives;

  • Ensure that the Department meets the curriculum requirements for the School;

  • Monitor and develop the quality of teaching, coaching and learning, through regular visits to lessons and otherwise, with a clear focus on excellence;

  • Implement a clear vision and structure for competitive inter-school sport across the School at Aiglon;

  • Implement a clear programme for inter-house sport at Aiglon. Liaise with the Director of Boarding and attend House Parent meetings where necessary to publicise and promote sporting initiatives, with clear communication to all stakeholders (students, staff and parents);

  • Promote and communicate to the Aiglon community initiatives and success stories from the Physical Education and Sport faculty, through weekly assemblies and the calendar alongside regular liaison with stakeholders in Admissions, Communications and Alumni teams;

  • Ensure that requirements of examination boards are met, and students are entered for public examinations, submitting appropriate coursework and ensuring that students are suitably prepared for examinations;

  • Preparing an annual report for the Deputy Director setting out an analysis of external examination results and value-added statistics;

  • Ensure, in consultation with the Deputy School Director the effective deployment of staff and classes within the Department;

  • Participate in the appointment of new staff, and support new staff entering the Department;

  • Ensure all members of the faculty take account of students' prior levels of attainment, and baseline data where relevant, and use these to set targets for future improvements;

  • Oversee all aspects of the organisation of tournaments, fixtures and trips where appropriate;

  • To be available for School sporting events including The Challenge, Sports Day and other major School events;

  • Booking of snowsports instructors for all students in the winter term, which will require close liaison with external ski school instructors used by Aiglon, ensuring a high level of instruction takes place and to ensure ability groups are monitored regularly;

  • Prepare faculty budget requests for both operational and capital expenditure, within specified deadlines;

  • Monitor and control the faculty expenditure, within agreed budgets, and ensure compliance with all finance policies and procedures;

  • Produce student participation and performance reports termly;

  • Be aware of any statutory requirements that affect the Department, including health and safety requirements, and ensure that the Department complies with these requirements;

  • Ensure that risk assessments are prepared in line with school policy;

  • Attend ADISR and SGIS meetings as appropriate;

  • Ensure the effective communication between Departments and Departmental staff, school committees, School Council and the Junior School;

  • Promote the effective use of the Centre for Enquiry, ICT and other resources within the Department and School;

  • Ensure that the Department is fully prepared for any inspections and accreditations.

Teaching and Tutoring

  • Teach an average of 16 academic lessons per week, in accordance with departmental schemes of work and programmes of study;

  • Liaise with relevant colleagues on the planning of units of work for collaborative delivery;

  • Ensure the faculty is working in collaboration with Aiglon’s programme of support for students with specific learning difficulties, as directed by the Head of Learning Support or the Deputy School Director;

  • Where relevant, set work for students absent from class for health, disciplinary or co-curricular reasons and ensure this is carried out by faculty members;

  • Where appropriate, prepare students thoroughly for public examinations including the marking and moderation of coursework and ensure this is also carried out by members of the faculty;

  • Engage with and promote the use of ICT and the development of appropriate ICT skills both within the curriculum and in wider school life and ensure this is also carried out by members of the department;

  • Maintain good discipline by adherence to the advice given to colleagues in the Student Handbook and elsewhere, and by the Head of Department and Deputy School Directors, and monitor to ensure that good discipline is replicated throughout the department;

  • Set high expectations for students' appearance and behaviour by establishing a purposeful working atmosphere in lessons and monitor that this is occurring throughout the faculty;

  • Set appropriate and demanding expectations for students' learning, motivation and presentation of work, in line with agreed school policies and monitor that this is occurring throughout the faculty;

  • Act as a tutor to an assigned group of students, exercising best practice in pastoral care and providing guidance and encouragement to students, as directed by Houseparents and Deputy School Directors. This will include the need to attend scheduled meetings at the Houseparents’ or Deputy School Directors’ discretion and meet with students outside of formal meeting times.

Assessment, Recording and Reporting

  • Ensure all members of the faculty maintain notes and plans of lessons undertaken and records of students’ work;

  • Ensure all within the faculty mark, monitor and return student work within a reasonable and agreed time span providing constructive oral and written feedback and clear targets for future learning as appropriate and keep records of students’ performance as required by the faculty marking policy or the Deputy School Director;

  • Complete student formative and summative assessments in line with policy and as specified in the published calendar and monitor that this is occurring throughout the faculty;

  • Ensure all members of the faculty are familiar with and apply procedures for identification and assessment of special educational needs, EAL requirements and other learning support issues;

  • Ensure all members of the faculty provide mark reading information and write detailed reports on students at the end of each term as required;

  • Ensure all members of the faculty attend parents’ meetings as designated in the school calendar.

Co-Curricular Duties

  • Contribute to the Activities and CAS programme on a weekly basis in consultation with the Director of Character;

  • Contribute to the annual Cultural Learning and Experience (CLE) and Aiglon Discovery Trips (ADT) in consultation with the Director of Character.

OTHER TASKS & RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Understand and implement all school policies and procedures, particularly those relating to safeguarding children and young people;

  • Undertake any other task which may be reasonably requested by the Deputy School Director to assist in the smooth running of the team;

  • Understand the School’s Guiding Principles and uphold the ethos of the School at all times.

title: Meat Lead - Store #25 Full-Time
description:
About Us
Northgate Gonzalez Market has grown from one store in Anaheim in 1980 to over 40 locations across Southern California, and we’re looking for passionate, customer-focused team members to join our family. We offer flexible schedules, opportunities for growth, and an associate discount of up to 20% for you and your household—all in a positive and fun work environment where you’ll feel valued and appreciated. If you’re enthusiastic, team-oriented, and ready to build a career with us, we’d love to meet you.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

The essential duties and responsibilities of this position include, but are not limited to, the following:

Leadership

  • Ensure that all associates are trained in the store's method of performing activities and functions.
  • Maintain a positive work environment and ensure a fair and consistent treatment of all associates.
  • Set a positive example of the company values and excellent customer service.
  • Meet department Voice of the Customer / SMG standards.
  • Recruit, select, on-board, coach, and develop the best associates possible to achieve store, company, strategic and tactical goals.
  • Set clear performance expectations for associates and follow-up with timely performance evaluations and proper compensation.

Operations

  • Adhere to all local, state, and federal regulations (e.g. weight and measures, COOL)
  • Follow approved receiving procedures to ensure product quality and rotation.
  • Maintaining & recording accurately inventory levels to maximize sales and optimize gross profit.
  • Follows merchandising standards and systems as defined schematics, productions planning, merchandising and display standards, known loss tacking.
  • Enforce and manage the local vendors to ensure proper service and inventory levels and standards.
  • Ensure that the correct retail prices are displayed in the scale labels and price tags and communicate any price discrepancies to the Scan Coordinator.
  • Maintain inventory control to ensure freshness, product quality and turnover for maximum sales and return-on-investment.
  • Control excessive use of utilities and water.
  • Control supplies inventory and expenses.
  • Ensure that proper cleaning routine is conducted at the end of the shift in accordance with the Company procedures.
  • Greet all customers and provide them with prompt and courteous service.
  • Execute all department programs to ensure that the customer service, employee productivity, and meat cases presentation are being met.
  • Maintain general housekeeping and sanitation standards in compliance with store policy and state and local health regulations on a regular, ongoing basis.
  • Implement all merchandising plans (e.g. schematics, new items, promotional programs) issued by the support center.
  • Oversee that all meat cuts are properly trimmed and displayed.
  • Ensure that all associates are utilizing the correct PLU that corresponds with the proper product trays in accordance with the weights and measures regulations.
  • Perform any other work-related duties as assigned.

Safety

Inspect and maintain equipment in good working conditions and immediately report any maintenance or equipment issues to Store Management.

Comply with company safety policies and procedures and ensure that all department associates do so as well also.

Participate in store's safety committee.

Notify Store Team Leader of safety policy violations that require disciplinary action.

Meet Northgate Standards / County Regulations on safe food handling.

Perform/manage all daily safety observations.

Comply/train with all department safety regulations.

Perform/manage daily Axonify participation.

Comply/train with recipe guidelines.

REQUIREMENTS AND CONDITIONS:

Education/Experience

  • High School diploma or equivalent are preferred.
  • One year of experience required in meat department operations.
  • Must be able to be relocated to a store within 20 miles from home depending on the needs of the business.

Certificates/License/Regulations

  • Food Handlers Certification
  • Forklift Certification

  • Sexual Harassment Prevention/Respect Values Training/Boss to Coach/Leading Through People

  • Issue Free Training

  • Meat Cutter Certification
  • Safety Leadership Training

Skills Required

  • Must be able to calculate figures and amounts such as discounts, gross margins, markup, percentages, proportions, ratios, volume and to apply concepts of basic algebra.
  • Ability to verify vendor invoice charges and counts, and complete required accounting reports.
  • Good listening and communication skills
  • Speak the English language to a level that provides good customer service.

Physical Demands and Work Conditions

  • The physical demands and work conditions described below are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Some requirements may be modified to accommodate individuals with disabilities:
  • While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to sit, stand, and use the hands to handle, finger, or feel objects, tools or controls.
  • The employee must occasionally exert or lift up to 80 pounds.
  • Be able to climb a ladder to retrieve items stored in overhead racks such as trays and wrapping material.
  • Have enough physical mobility or agility to be able to respond quickly to fire or other emergencies and enough dexterity to disassemble and clean meat department saws, grinders, and other equipment.
  • Be able to work continuously in refrigerated coolers and cutting rooms and be able to endure working under temperature extremes (as low as 20®F below zero) in frozen food storage boxes for up to 40 minutes at a time wearing protective clothing, (taking breaks).
  • Typically, the noise level in the work environment is moderate; however, on occasion, it can be extremely noisy when the employee must enter the compressor/machine room to check on refrigeration equipment or when working with power tools and equipment.

IMPORTANT DISCLAIMER NOTICE

The job duties, elements, responsibilities, skills, functions, experience, educational factors, and the requirements and conditions listed in this job description are representative only and not exhaustive of the tasks that an employee may be required to perform. The Employer reserves the right to revise this job description at any time and to require employees to perform other tasks as circumstances or conditions of its business or the work environment change.

Northgate Markets is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Your Right to Work – In compliance with federal law, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work in the United States and to complete the required employment eligibility verification document form upon hire.

title: Client Partner
description:
At Red River Managed Services, we provide a welcoming and positive workplace where everyone feels valued and able to do their best work, fostering a one-team mentality. Our employees work together to foster wise decision-making that relies on data, experience, and collaboration. We seek self-motivated individuals who are open to an environment based on this teamwork and shared success.

Our team works directly with our clients to create innovative solutions, challenge the status quo, and deliver first in class solutions. Our client-centric culture works to anticipate needs with an urgency to resolve issues and build long-term client relationships.

We aim to expand our growing workforce with passionate individuals who are resilient in the face of uncertainty and possess a creative spirit, all while keeping the needs of our clients top of mind to foster individual and organizational success. Interested candidates must possess a desire for growth through continuous learning and feedback.

Ideal candidates will possess the following skills and come prepared to discuss how they have experienced each of these areas in previous roles:

  • Collaboration — You bring a collaborative spirit to all interactions with others; you work to ensure everyone around you is welcomed and positioned to do their best work; you view every Red River colleague as a member of one team.

  • Creativity— You welcome new ideas and listen with the intent to understand; you are passionate and persistent in pursuit of innovative solutions; you value “brainstorming” as an expression.

  • Empathy — You take the time to understand both the needs of your clients and your team members; you anticipate client needs and address issues effectively; you work to make each client feel valued and understood; you foster loyalty and a long-term relationship.

  • Integrity — You willingly receive and give feedback; you are open about what’s working and what needs to improve; you admit mistakes openly and share learnings widely.

  • Judgment — You are intentional when making decisions, with an aim toward long-term solutions rather than quick fixes; you rely on data, training, and collaboration with others to inform your decisions.

  • Purpose— You exhibit courage in searching for the truth; you are willing to risk personal failure to help, or challenge the status quo, in the pursuit of excellence.

  • Resilience — You thrive in rapidly changing circumstances; you adapt to change; you know when to include or escalate to others; you embrace a hard challenge.

  • Selflessness — You are considerate when searching for new and different ideas; you seek what’s best for the team and organization; you discern how your actions could affect others; you seek to make those around you successful.

Client Partner – Red River

Red River is seeking a resilient, data-driven, and operationally disciplined Client Partner to lead a portfolio of managed services accounts within the Property Management and Manufacturing verticals. Proven leader who thrives under scrutiny, takes full ownership of performance metrics, and drives strategic growth through vertical alignment, client retention and delivery excellence.

Ideal candidate will confidently navigate executive reviews, defend decisions with clarity and data, and adapt quickly with accountability. Emotional resilience, financial fluency, and deep vertical expertise are essential.

Key Responsibilities

Portfolio Leadership & Vertical Strategy

· Own and grow a portfolio of SMB to enterprise-level accounts within Property Management and Manufacturing vertical.

· Drive vertical strategy execution, aligning Red River’s offerings to industry-specific needs.

· Segment accounts strategically—invest in high-value clients, contain costs in transactional ones.

Client Success & Retention

· Ensure long-term client satisfaction through proactive engagement, delivery governance, and operational excellence.

· Lead onboarding and steady-state operations with a focus on measurable outcomes.

Financial Ownership & P&L Management

· Full accountability for revenue, cost, and margin performance across the portfolio.

· Identify and remediate anomalies (e.g., margin compression, billing errors, delivery inefficiencies).

· Link CRM forecasts to P&L performance and escalate contract risks with urgency.

· Drive cost-to-serve optimization, SLA adherence, and resource utilization.

· Demonstrate familiarity with MSP economics – costs-to-server, resource utilization, SLA penalties and gross margin levers.

Sales Partnership & Growth

· Collaborate with sales to structure deals, price recurring revenue contracts, and identify upsell opportunities.

· Influence pipeline development through vertical insights and client feedback.

Delivery Governance

· Monitor delivery dashboards and ERP outputs to ensure operational hygiene.

· Intervene directly when delivery inefficiencies threaten margin or client satisfaction.

Required Qualifications

· 5+ years of client-facing P&L ownership across multiple accounts, ideally in regulated or enterprise verticals.

· Proven success managing portfolios between $2M–$5M, with measurable impact on revenue growth and margin expansion.

· Deep understanding of MSP economics, including cost-to-serve models, SLA penalties, and gross margin levers.

· Executive presence with the ability to engage and influence C-suite stakeholders.

· Strong command of forecasting tools, delivery metrics, and financial modeling.

· Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional teams and manage third-party service providers.

Preferred Qualifications

· Experience in Property Management and/or Manufacturing industries.

· Familiarity with ServiceNow and ITIL framework.

· Exposure to deal structuring and pricing strategy in managed services.

description:

Works as part of an engineering team to analyze, design, integrate, and test radio frequency (RF) communications and C5ISR systems for DoD customers. Supports the full system lifecycle, from requirements and RF analysis through installation, test, and sustainment at shore sites and on mobile and fixed platforms. Collaborates with government engineers, program offices, and external stakeholders, and prepares technical reports, briefs, and test documentation. May provide technical direction to junior engineers and technicians.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • RF systems engineering for military communications systems (e.g., HF/VHF/UHF, SATCOM, line-of-sight data links, and tactical radios).
  • Perform RF analyses including link budgets, propagation and coverage studies, interference analysis, and antenna selection and placement.
  • Support RF integration, installation, and site surveys, including antenna, transmission line, and RF distribution design.
  • Plan and conduct RF test and troubleshooting using laboratory and field test equipment; document results and recommend corrective actions.
  • Support electromagnetic interference / electromagnetic compatibility (EMI/EMC) and spectrum supportability activities.
  • Develop and review technical documentation, including requirements, design and installation drawings, test procedures, and reports.

MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS:

EDUCATION

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering or Electrical and Computer Engineering, with coursework or a concentration in RF, microwave, electromagnetics, antennas, or communications systems. Candidates without formal RF coursework will be considered if they have equivalent professional RF engineering experience.
    • Engineering degrees shall be from an Accreditation Board for Engineering and Technology (ABET) accredited program (see ). Note: Technology degrees do not qualify as Engineering or Physical Science Degrees.

EXPERIENCE

  • We will entertain varying years of professional engineering experience involving hands-on design, analysis, integration, or test of RF communications systems or components.
  • Practical experience with standard RF test equipment such as spectrum analyzers, vector network analyzers, signal generators, and power meters.
  • Experience with RF simulation software and setting up and conducting studies.

CLEARANCE

  • Current active Secret, with reasonable expectation of eligibility for a TS/SCI with CI Polygraph clearance in the future.

REQUIRED SKILLS:

  • Solid working knowledge of RF fundamentals: transmission lines, impedance matching, antennas, noise, modulation, and propagation.
  • Ability to perform and document link budgets and RF performance calculations.
  • Ability to read and interpret schematics, block diagrams, and installation drawings.
  • Understanding of test, verification, and system integration within a systems engineering context.
  • Ability to communicate effectively with non-technical stakeholders, translating complex technical issues into clear recommendations and actionable tasks.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to learn new systems and tools quickly.
  • Familiarity with DoD cybersecurity and configuration management practices.

LOCATION:

  • The work location is on-site at North Charleston, SC, with 10-20% travel expected for site surveys, installations, and testing. Some travel may be OCONUS.

ADDITIONAL DESIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE (these are a Plus)

  • Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering with an RF, microwave, or communications focus.
  • RF modeling and simulation tools (e.g., Keysight ADS, Ansys HFSS, CST Studio, MATLAB/Simulink) or propagation/coverage tools (e.g., Remcom Wireless InSite, ATDI HTZ, or similar).
  • Experience with SATCOM terminals (e.g., MUOS, commercial Ku/Ka-band) or tactical data links (e.g., Link 16).
  • Software-defined radio (SDR) experience (e.g., GNU Radio, Ettus USRP) or scripting for test automation (e.g., Python).
  • EMI/EMC testing experience, including familiarity with MIL-STD-461 and MIL-STD-464.
  • Shipboard, vehicle, or shore-site C5ISR installation experience, including NAVSEA or NIWC installation processes.
  • Electronic Warfare (EW), Signals Intelligence (SIGINT), or spectrum management experience.

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER:

Fathom 4, LLC. is an equal opportunity employer that does not discriminate in employment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to their race, color, religion, sex, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, or national origin, disability, or protected veteran status.

title: Production Planner
description:
SHAPING THE FUTURE THROUGH INNOVATION AND DISCOVERY!

With a history spanning more than seven decades, Communications & Power Industries’ thousands of products have impacted people’s lives in numerous unseen ways every day. Our highly engineered products serve as the backbone of modern-day commercial and military communications systems, assist in diagnosing medical conditions, empower scientific discoveries and space exploration, and much more.

CPI is headquartered in Plano, Texas and is a global manufacturer of electronic components and subsystems. We have manufacturing locations in the United States, Canada, Europe, and Asia. With a heritage of technological excellence, our team serves customers in the communications, defense, medical, industrial, and scientific markets.

YOUR DAY TO DAY:

We are looking for a Production Planner who will be responsible for translating demand, forecast, and engineering program milestones into executable production plans across sustaining, New Product Introduction (NPI), and large program builds. This role balances material availability, capacity, and inventory exposure to keep the plant material-clear and on schedule, while also acting as the planning-side owner for assigned engineering and program milestones — ensuring project deliverables actually convert into scheduled, executable work. The role collaborates closely with Production, Supply Chain, Engineering, Program Management, Quality, and Procurement.

YOU WILL BE ACCOUNTABLE FOR/TO:

Production Planning & Scheduling

  • Develop and maintain production schedules across assigned product lines, sequencing work orders to balance customer demand, capacity, and material availability.
  • Translate demand and forecast into time-phased production requirements, feeding and maintaining accuracy within the MRP system.
  • Release and confirm work orders in the ERP system; manage WIP tracking, order status, and shop-floor confirmation.
  • Adjust schedules in response to delays, equipment issues, or material shortages, and communicate changes to stakeholders
  • Perform monthly, quarterly and yearly planning cycles to ensure builds are clear to build

Materials & Inventory Management

  • Perform material availability and critical-path analysis; identify and escalate shortages and constraints ahead of impact.
  • Manage production kit readiness with cross-functional partners with Engineering and Operations.
  • Maintain the integrity of shop floor, MRP, and inventory data through key performance metrics.
  • Calculate and manage inventory exposure as forecasts and builds change, balancing supply against demand to minimize excess and obsolescence risk.

Program & Project Planning

  • Act as the planning-side lead for assigned engineering and program milestones, ensuring project deliverables are translated into scheduled, executable production work.
  • Track program and project milestones against the production schedule, flagging risks to timing and coordinating recovery plans with Program Management and Engineering.
  • Support Engineering during ECN/ECO processes, assessing material and schedule impact and recommending cutover dates to limit disruption and obsolescence.
  • Coordinate materials planning for new products to ensure parts are ordered and delivered in a timely fashion to support program timelines

Problem Solving & Continuous Improvement

  • Identify and highlight potential risks and constraints to on-time completion of the schedule.
  • Perform root cause and corrective action (RCCA) on planning and schedule-related issues to prevent recurrence.
  • Support and participate in scheduling, planning, and workflow improvement initiatives.
  • Support and Lead KPI tracking (e.g., OTD, MSA, Stock Outs).

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Serve as a key planning point of contact for assigned product lines and programs, working closely with Buyers, Engineering, Operations, Quality, and Finance.
  • Maintain strong working relationships across key departments to support on-time delivery.
  • Quote factory lead times based on material availability and production capacity.

    YOU ARE THE RIGHT PERSON FOR THIS JOB IF YOU HAVE:

    • Post-secondary education in Supply Chain, Operations, or a related field.
    • 4+ years of experience in production planning, scheduling, or a related manufacturing planning role.
    • Exposure to program/project coordination — e.g., NPI, engineering milestone tracking, or cross-functional project support — is a strong asset.
    • Proficiency with ERP/MRP systems; JD Edwards a strong asset.
    • Strong MS Office skills (Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, Word).
    • Working knowledge of forecasting, production processes, capacity constraints, and inventory management.
    • APICS/CPIM certification an asset.
    • Strong communication and organizational skills, with the ability to work across disciplines and multiple levels of the organization.
    • Ability to multitask and work well under schedule pressure and critical due dates in a fast-paced environment.
    • High attention to detail.
    • Must be able to meet all CGP requirements.

      WHO WE ARE:

      We value the unique and diverse skills, qualities, and backgrounds that each employee brings to CPI, and we respect each employee as an integral member of our growing team. CPI is committed to providing equal employment opportunities for all current and prospective employees, as well as to promoting a culture of inclusion and respect for everyone. We celebrate the innovation that diversity creates in the work environment, and we recognize that each employee brings their own unique capabilities, experiences, and perspectives to the organization. It is this variety that adds value to our teams, as well as to our stakeholders. We welcome and encourage applicants to reach their full potential with us.

      CPI is proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, sexual stereotypes, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

      WHAT WE OFFER:

      Whether you are a seasoned professional or just embarking on your career, CPI is an ideal place to expand your knowledge and expertise. We cultivate a healthy, dynamic, and team-oriented environment that empowers our employees to develop, create and deliver innovative, reliable technology solutions to power, connect, protect, and support a better tomorrow.

title: Head of Engineering
location: New York, New York, United States
description:
Location: US, Remote (Eastern Hours)

About BOI

BOI is the AI partner that Walmart, Coca-Cola, and Mastercard call when AI needs to drive growth, not just savings. We rebuild how work gets done, starting from the outcomes each team exists to deliver: agents do the work, people own the judgment, and the capacity it frees goes to growth. We bring together the unusually strong in frontier enterprise AI, then give them the ownership to make it happen. If you're looking for a comfortable place to hide, we're not it. If you want to build the future of enterprise AI with people who will make you better: welcome home.

Your Role

Own the Technical Build

  • Own the architecture and engineering quality of every client build, from first prototype to production in the client's environment.
  • Shape solution architecture across models, clouds and platforms, and make build, buy or configure calls you can defend to a client CTO. Our clients run on Azure, AWS and Google Cloud. We're independent of every vendor, so the answer is whatever is best for the client.
  • Set the engineering standards every build meets: evaluation of AI outputs, security and data governance, observability, and production reliability.
  • Build the reusable components, patterns and internal products that let each engagement start further ahead than the last.

Lead with Clients

  • Sit with client CTOs, CIOs and business executives as BOI's senior technical voice. Explain technical choices in terms of cost, risk and value, so non-technical leaders can decide.
  • Lead client security, compliance and procurement reviews, and get our systems approved to run in their environments.
  • Work forward deployed: get into client environments early, build alongside their teams, and keep building as the relationship grows.

Shape What We Sell

  • Scope and estimate builds for proposals with our Directors of Applied AI, so what we sell can be built on time and to standard.
  • Turn what we've built into case studies, reusable IP and technical thought leadership.

Build the Team

  • Lead, coach and grow our engineering team, roughly doubling it over the next year. Set high standards, give direct feedback, and give credit generously.
  • Run AI-first ways of working across engineering, with your own tools and workflows as the example.
  • Help build BOI like an owner, alongside our leadership team in the US and Europe.

What We Look For

We are deliberately not for everyone. We look for a specific combination of qualities:

  • You've shipped AI systems to production at enterprise scale, inside environments with real security, compliance and data constraints.
  • You've led engineering in a consultancy, agency or other project-based environment. You're comfortable with work that changes shape every few months and with stacks you didn't choose.
  • You've founded a company or been early at a startup. You can build the team as well as the system, and you make good decisions before everything is known.
  • You explain technical choices to non-technical executives in plain language, and they leave the room ready to decide.

What We Offer

  • You'll set the technical direction of a growing AI company and shape how BOI builds in every market we work in.
  • You'll build compounding skills at the frontier of AI while others are still catching up.
  • What your team builds goes live in client systems within weeks, and you see the value it creates.
  • We're independent of every vendor, so you work across every model and cloud, building with whatever is best and swapping it when something better ships.
  • You get the freedom to prototype, experiment, and push boundaries on what's possible with AI.

Benefits

We also offer comprehensive health benefits, 401(k), 25 days PTO, hybrid working (if based out of NYC), professional development support, and the opportunity to work alongside some of the world's leading AI practitioners on high-impact enterprise transformations.

BOI is an equal opportunity employer: we celebrate diversity and welcome all backgrounds and identities.

Requisition ID: 21846

Job Title: Flower Technician II

Department: Processing

Reports to: Manufacturing Supervisor or Team Lead

FLSA Status: Non-Exempt, Hourly

Location: Midway, FL

POSITION SUMMARY

The Flower Technician II is responsible for ensuring incoming cannabis flower materials by confirming specifications, confirming compliance accordance; conducting visual and measurement tests; assist in printing labels; rejecting and returning unacceptable materials.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Perform incoming inspections (moisture, texture, overall quality, size through sort, etc.) of incoming batches of flower and pre roll material before machine operation
  • Ensure proper bud size per brand standard, weigh out and package flower and/or pre rolls after machine operation
  • Receive raw batched items and ensure appropriate storage between runs
  • Coordinate with team members to meet daily packaging goals and standards
  • Verify product packages per quality control standards before finalizing batches
  • Organize and stage products for packaging operations, maintaining workflow efficiency
  • Perform all counts (batches, case packs, etc.) and fill out all required documentation
  • Seal bags/jars/tubes through equipment, inspecting quality to ensure seal is to standard
  • Prepare and apply labels to bags/jars/boxes of product secondary labels, ensuring compliance in accordance with product and label specifications
  • Ensure cleaning processes, verification paperwork is filled out, and PPE per cGMP and Trulieve standards are being performed
  • Depending on assigned work area, assist with printing batch labels to avoid delays in production
  • Train Flower Technician I to packaging, machine fill, label in job duties to quality standards
  • Maintain detailed records of completed tasks for documentation and traceability
  • Collaborate with the inventory teams and leadership to resolve discrepancies in documentation
  • Monitor and fill any automated packaging and/or pre roll equipment operations efficiently
  • Notify leads of any quality, machine operation, and material challenges when they occur
  • Attend to other job duties as assigned by management

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Controls and instrumentation experience
  • Ensure timeliness of return from breaks
  • Work in a fast-paced controlled environment
  • Work with chemicals, oils, and sharp objects
  • Processing quality experience a plus
  • Able to work under minimum supervision
  • Able to work under pressure
  • Able to manage changes in working schedule
  • Minimum 6 months in the Flower Technician I role
  • SAP/state mandated system (Metrc, Biotrack, MJ Freeway) basic entry experience preferred
  • Outstanding communication and organizational skills

ADDITIONAL MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

  • High School Diploma or equivalent
  • Must be a minimum of 21 years of age (or a minimum of 18 years of age in CT, PA and WV)
  • Must successfully complete a comprehensive background screening

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

  • Work in close proximity and with cannabis flower and particulates on a daily basis.
  • Must be able to push, pull, move, and/or lift a minimum of 50 lbs to a minimum height of 5 feet and able to push, pull, move, and/or carry such weight a minimum distance of 50 feet, with or without mechanical assistance
  • Must be able to work seated/standing as appropriate at workstations for extended periods of time, maintain body equilibrium while climbing ladders, stairways, stopping, kneeling, crouching, and reaching, and use hands/fingers to hold, grasp, turn, pick, pinch frequently/constantly to complete tasks
  • Must be able to handle organic matter daily, able to wear PPE as appropriate (eye, face, hand, arm, head, foot, body, fall protection)
  • Must have visual acuity with/without job aids to perform activities such as; reading, viewing a computer terminal, visual inspection involving small parts/details. Clarity of vision at 20 ft or more in day and night/dark conditions
  • Must be able to speak and communicate at conversational proficiency with co-workers and leadership (Moderate noise)

WORK SCHEDULE

40 hours weekly. Must be available to work occasional evenings, weekends and holidays.

Please apply directly through our official careers site or authorized recruitment channels. Using third-party application services may create issues with your applicant profile and lead to processing delays.

Salary will be commensurate with experience. A comprehensive benefits package including paid time off is offered with this position.

title: Fire Operations Supervisor
description:

  • Ability to quickly learn new software applications utilized by company.
  • Must demonstrate commitment to compliance with applicable laws and regulations, an unwavering commitment to safety and health and other company policies and procedures.
  • Must possess high ethical standards demonstrated by their approach to business.
  • Must demonstrate leadership and the ability to coordinate resources to achieve maximum profitability, efficiency, and utilization.
  • Must understand and effectively manage key financial issues that impact service and operations functions and the business.
  • Experience with budget preparation and cost control.
  • Must be able to prepare accurate, effective, complete, and easily understood written communications and reports.
  • Proficiency in the care and use of all sites specific, facility and customer required Personal Protection Equipment (PPE).

Working Environment:

Works in customer environment. May be exposed to high pressure, chemicals, and traffic. The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate.

title: Senior Pathologist (AI Clinical Evaluation)
description:
Gramian Consultancy is a boutique consultancy specializing in IT professional services and engineering talent solutions. With a strong background in software engineering and leadership, we help companies build high-performing teams by matching them with professionals who truly fit their needs.

Role Overview

We are looking for an experienced Senior Pathologist to contribute to an AI training and evaluation project focused on clinical reasoning, diagnostic accuracy, pathology interpretation, longitudinal chart review, and patient safety.

The role involves creating and reviewing complex pathology-focused clinical tasks, long-chart scenarios, gold-standard answers, and evaluation rubrics. You will assess whether outputs reflect accurate diagnostic reasoning, appropriate interpretation of pathology findings, sound clinical correlation, complete documentation, and clinically defensible conclusions.

CONTRACT: Contractor assignment, 12 weeks

COMMITMENT: Part-time or Full-time (20-40h/week)

LOCATIONS: Remote - Bangladesh, Brazil, Colombia, Egypt, Ghana, India, Indonesia, Nigeria, Turkey

PROCESS: The selection will be made based on an online questionnaire, 60min MCQ test, and resume/education/certification

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop high-difficulty pathology and laboratory medicine cases and benchmark tasks.
  • Review pathology reports, laboratory findings, clinical history, and longitudinal medical records.
  • Identify clinically significant findings, inconsistencies, missing information, diagnostic risks, and documentation gaps.
  • Evaluate AI-generated outputs for diagnostic accuracy, clinical relevance, terminology, completeness, and patient safety.
  • Create gold-standard answers and clinically defensible reference solutions.
  • Assess whether pathology interpretations are appropriately correlated with clinical context and other diagnostic findings.
  • Review differential diagnoses and identify unsupported or unsafe conclusions.
  • Apply structured rubrics to evaluate reasoning, terminology, documentation quality, and clinical accuracy.
  • Participate in peer review and calibration of complex or ambiguous cases.
  • Incorporate feedback and refine tasks through iterative review cycles.

Requirements

  • Medical degree or equivalent professional qualification with specialization in Pathology / Laboratory Medicine.
  • Active or recently held professional license, registration, board certification, or recognized pathology credential in the candidate’s country.
  • Approximately 8+ years of professional pathology experience.
  • Strong diagnostic experience interpreting pathology findings and correlating them with clinical information.
  • Strong ability to review complex, fragmented, or longitudinal medical records.
  • Experience producing or reviewing formal diagnostic reports and clinical documentation.
  • Strong written English and ability to provide precise, clinically defensible reasoning.
