description:
A leading multispecialty hospital in Dubai, United Arab Emirates is expanding its oral and maxillofacial surgery services and is seeking a qualified Consultant / Specialist Oral & Maxillofacial Surgeon to join its multidisciplinary surgical and dental specialty team. The role focuses on providing advanced surgical care for conditions affecting the oral cavity, jaws, facial bones, and related soft tissues within a modern hospital environment supported by advanced imaging, specialised surgical facilities, and integrated specialty care.

This position offers an opportunity to practice comprehensive oral and maxillofacial surgery while collaborating with specialists in dentistry, plastic surgery, otolaryngology, oncology, and trauma care to deliver high-quality treatment for patients requiring complex facial and jaw procedures.

Role Overview

• Position: Consultant / Specialist Oral & Maxillofacial Surgeon
• Location: Dubai, United Arab Emirates
• Healthcare Setting: Multispecialty hospital with advanced surgical and dental specialty services
• Experience Required: Minimum 3+ years post specialist or board certification
• Practice Model: Combination of outpatient consultations, surgical procedures, and multidisciplinary treatment planning

The successful candidate will diagnose and surgically manage diseases, injuries, and structural conditions involving the mouth, jaws, face, and neck, ensuring high standards of patient safety and surgical care.

Qualifications & Requirements – Consultant / Specialist Oral & Maxillofacial Surgeon

• Medical/Dental degree (MBBS / BDS) followed by a recognised specialist qualification in Oral & Maxillofacial Surgery

• Recognised higher qualification such as:

  • MDS / DNB / FCPS (Oral & Maxillofacial Surgery)
  • American Board of Oral & Maxillofacial Surgery
  • UK CCT / FRCS (Oral & Maxillofacial Surgery)
  • European Board Certification in Oral & Maxillofacial Surgery
  • Royal College Certification (Canada)
  • Australian Fellowship (FRACDS or equivalent)
  • Arab Board in Oral & Maxillofacial Surgery
  • Or equivalent internationally recognised qualification

• Minimum 3–5 years post-specialisation experience in Oral & Maxillofacial Surgery within a hospital or advanced clinical setting

Key Responsibilities – Oral & Maxillofacial Surgery

• Diagnose and treat conditions affecting the oral cavity, jawbones, facial structures, and surrounding soft tissues
• Perform surgical procedures including impacted wisdom tooth extraction, dental implant placement, corrective jaw surgery (orthognathic surgery), and facial trauma reconstruction
• Manage facial fractures and traumatic injuries involving the jaw, cheekbones, and surrounding structures
• Treat oral pathology such as cysts, tumors, infections, and other abnormalities of the oral and maxillofacial region
• Perform reconstructive procedures for congenital deformities, trauma-related defects, and functional jaw disorders
• Evaluate and manage temporomandibular joint (TMJ) disorders and associated functional complications
• Collaborate with orthodontists, prosthodontists, ENT specialists, plastic surgeons, and oncology teams for comprehensive patient care
• Conduct pre-operative assessments, surgical planning, and post-operative follow-up care
• Utilise advanced diagnostic imaging such as CT scans and 3D imaging to support surgical planning and treatment evaluation
• Maintain accurate clinical documentation and patient records in accordance with regulatory and institutional standards
• Participate in clinical audits, quality improvement initiatives, and professional development activities
• Ensure adherence to infection control protocols, surgical safety guidelines, and UAE healthcare regulations

Compensation & Benefits

• Performance-based incentives
• Housing allowance or accommodation support

• Annual return flight tickets
• Professional indemnity / malpractice coverage
• Continuing Medical Education (CME) support

Licensing & Relocation Support

title: Head – PMS
description:
# Head – Portfolio Management Services (PMS)

## Job Summary
The Head of Portfolio Management Services (PMS) will lead the overall investment strategy, portfolio performance, and growth of the PMS business. Reporting directly to the CEO, this role is responsible for overseeing portfolio construction, investment governance, and regulatory compliance. The incumbent will lead a team of Fund Managers and Research Analysts to deliver superior risk-adjusted returns aligned with client objectives and market conditions.

## Responsibilities
- **Investment Strategy & Asset Allocation:** Formulate and execute top-down and bottom-up investment strategies for PMS mandates. Oversee stock selection, portfolio structuring, and sector allocation aligned with client risk profiles and market dynamics.
- **Portfolio Management & Performance Monitoring:** Maintain active oversight of investment decisions across all PMS strategies. Rigorously monitor portfolio performance against designated benchmarks and risk metrics. Conduct periodic portfolio reviews to rebalance holdings and optimize risk-adjusted returns.
- **Team Leadership & Mentorship:** Direct, mentor, and guide a dedicated team of 3–4 Fund Managers and Research Analysts. Foster a disciplined, institutionalized, and research-backed investment culture within the team.
- **Risk Management & Governance:** Implement strict risk controls, mandate compliance, and liquidity standards across portfolios. Ensure full compliance with internal risk limits, Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) PMS regulations, and statutory requirements.
- **Equity Research & Market Insights:** Lead deep-dive equity research efforts to identify high-conviction investment opportunities across market capitalizations. Track macroeconomic trends, industry dynamics, and corporate earnings performance.
- **Strategic Alignment:** Collaborate closely with the CEO and senior investment leadership to align PMS objectives with the broader organization's vision. Represent the PMS investment philosophy during high-level client interactions, wealth partner meetings, and institutional briefings as required.

## Qualifications
- Post-graduate degree in Business Administration or Finance from a premier institute; Chartered Accountant (CA) or Chartered Financial Analyst (CFA) charter holder strongly preferred.
- Deep understanding of equity valuation, financial modeling, capital allocation, and risk management frameworks.
- Strong leadership capabilities with a proven history of developing investment talent.

## Experience
- Preferably 15+ years of experience in equity portfolio management, equity research, or fund management within a reputed Portfolio Management Service (PMS), Mutual Fund, or Alternate Investment Fund (AIF).
- Demonstrated strong, verifiable long-term investment track record with superior risk-adjusted returns across market cycles.

## Environment
- Position reports directly to the CEO.
- Leads a team of 3–4 Fund Managers and Research Analysts.
- Department: Fund Management – Portfolio Management Services.
- Band Designation: 8/9.
- Work setting details such as location or remote/in-office status are not specified.

title: Director, Data & Quality
description:

Catholic Charities of Baltimore is seeking a Director of Data and Quality to lead the systems, standards, and insights that drive safe, equitable, effective, and accountable service delivery across the Division. Integrating quality assurance, performance, data governance, client experience, professional practice, and risk, the Director turns information into action, aligns stakeholders around shared priorities, and advances sustainable improvement. This position is expected to work in close partnership with the Director of Performance Management, supporting agency-wide performance initiatives and ensuring divisional practices align with organizational standards and priorities. Through strategic influence and disciplined oversight, the Director strengthens outcomes, accountability, and mission impact.

The work schedule is Monday to Friday 8 AM - 4 PM or 8:30 AM - 4:30 PM.

JOB DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES:

Quality Assurance, Performance & Data Governance

  • Provides strategic oversight of divisional quality assurance, performance management, data governance, and continuous improvement, establishing standards and accountability that align services with organizational priorities and promote equitable, trauma-informed, outcomes-driven practice.
  • Leads divisional performance management reviews in alignment with agency-wide performance standards and in coordination with the Director of Performance Management; establishes and monitors measurable goals and key performance indicators, evaluates results, assigns follow-up actions, and works with divisional leadership to ensure accountability for timely, sustained improvement.
  • Partners closely with the agency's Director of Performance Management to advance agency-wide standards for data integrity, performance accountability, client outcomes, and continuous quality improvement.
  • Serves as the Division's primary liaison for agency-wide performance initiatives and is responsible for responding to requests, facilitating reviews of program operations, data collection practices, and client service processes, and ensuring that identified improvements are implemented in a timely and effective manner.
  • Directs data governance, quality controls, workflows, and documentation standards to ensure information is accurate, timely, compliant, audit-ready, and consistently usable for decision-making and reporting across programs.
  • Analyzes program, client, and operational data to identify trends, risks, strengths, and performance gaps; translates findings into recommendations and actions that improve outcomes, service effectiveness, and resource decisions.
  • Partners with divisional leaders to design, implement, monitor, and evaluate quality-improvement initiatives; establishes corrective actions and verifies that changes are completed, sustained, and achieve intended results.
  • Partners with divisional leaders and Development to define, monitor, validate, and report measurable program and grant outcomes that demonstrate effectiveness, meet funder requirements, and inform future strategy.
  • Serves as the Division’s technical systems administrator for ServicePoint and HMIS platforms, accountable for system configuration, permissions, licensing, integrations, vendor coordination, troubleshooting, data transfers, compliant use, and data continuity; serves as functional lead for EHR and other systems, supporting training, workflows, adoption, and data quality.
  • Directs the development and maintenance of standard operating procedures, user guidance, and recurring agency, program, and grant reports, ensuring staff and stakeholders receive clear requirements and accurate, actionable information.

Strategic Partnership & Client Experience

  • Serves on the Community Services Leadership Team, providing quality, performance, data, risk, and client-experience expertise that informs divisional strategy, resource priorities, operational decisions, and executive accountability.
  • Partners with program leaders to assess operations and system effectiveness, identify gaps, risks, and emerging needs, and ensure agreed improvements are implemented, monitored, and sustained.
  • Leads change management for new standards, systems, and practices by engaging stakeholders, communicating expectations, addressing barriers, clarifying accountability, and monitoring adoption and effectiveness.
  • Oversees client satisfaction measurement and integrates client feedback with performance data to establish priorities, shape training and practice improvements, and strengthen the client experience.
  • Establishes and monitors trauma-informed, ethical, equitable, and consistent professional practice standards for staff serving complex and high-risk populations, addressing gaps through guidance, training, and corrective action.
  • Researches and evaluates evidence-informed practices and process improvements; develops training, resources, and tools that support implementation, strengthen program effectiveness, and promote consistent outcome measurement.

Compliance & Emergency Preparedness

  • Directs divisional risk management, ensuring potential and actual risks and incidents are promptly identified, documented, investigated, mitigated, escalated, and reported in accordance with agency standards and applicable requirements.

title: Deposit Operations Associate - Hybrid
description:
Why You’ll Love Working at Quorum

At Quorum Federal Credit Union, we are a cutting-edge credit union that operates as a technology company, delivering innovative financial solutions to our members. We thrive on collaboration and recognize outstanding performance. We are the ideal workplace for self-motivated individuals who are committed to organizational success and eager to join a dynamic team of professionals. If you are looking for a place where you can make a meaningful impact, enjoy a flexible and fulfilling work experience, and be part of a forward-thinking team, Quorum Federal Credit Union is the perfect fit for you.

How You’ll Make an Impact

The Deposit Operations Associate supports day-to-day deposit and payment operations including Real Time Payments (RTP), ACH and wire transfers, exception processing, dispute management, reconciliations, and account maintenance activities. The role also supports procedure management, system testing, operational reporting, vendor coordination, and continuous process improvement initiatives. This position serves as a subject matter expert in deposit operations and electronic payment processing while helping ensure operational accuracy, regulatory compliance, strong internal controls, and an exceptional member experience.

The ideal candidate must be competent and able to learn quickly, be highly detail-oriented, and be comfortable working with many different systems. The successful candidate will have worked in a financial institution setting, primarily in back-office transaction processing. This person will possess strong analytical and problem-solving skills and demonstrate the ability to identify opportunities that improve efficiency, controls, service quality, and the member experience. Exposure to process automation, RPA technologies, and AI-enabled workflow tools is preferred and may provide future development opportunities within the Operations team.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Performs ACH, wire transfer, RTP, deposit, and related payment processing activities including transaction posting, account maintenance, exception resolution, payment investigations, transaction research, and dispute processing.
  • Accountable for assigned processes and accurately completing these functions, within expected time frames, and within acceptable service level standards set by Management.
  • Monitors activity, tracks transactions, and validates data using reports and logs. Escalates issues appropriately.
  • Identifies and recommends process improvements that enhance operational efficiency, strengthen controls, improve service quality, and reduce operational risk. Participates in systems testing, implementation activities, reporting enhancements, and operational readiness reviews.

Provides occasional support for fulfillment operations, document imaging, mail processing, and notary services as business needs require. These responsibilities represent a secondary component of the role and are expected to comprise a limited percentage of overall job responsibilities.
  • Maintains and updates assigned procedures, operating documentation, and policy sections. Recommends enhancements that support operational efficiency, accuracy, risk management, and regulatory compliance.
  • Collaborate with members, vendors, business partners, and internal departments to resolve operational issues, support payment processing activities, and improve service delivery. Participates in projects involving system updates, implementations, testing, and operational enhancements.

  • Keeps abreast of industry developments including, but not limited to, changes in regulations, technology, etc.
  • Ensures adherence to company policies and procedures and Banking/Credit Union Regulations.
  • Performs additional duties as required.

What You Bring to the Team

The Deposit Operations Associate works under minimal supervision following established guidelines and procedures exercising some independent judgment. This person must be action-oriented, self-motivated, and creative while being highly functional.

  • Minimum six months of experience in back-office payment processing within a bank or credit union environment, including ACH processing, wire transfers, deposit operations, or a combination of these functions. Experience processing transactions, researching exceptions, and resolving payment-related issues is required.
  • High school diploma required, Bachelors degree preferred
  • Notary Public commission preferred. If required for business needs, Quorum will support the notary commissioning process, training, and associated fees.
  • Exposure to process automation, workflow optimization, AI-enabled operational tools, or robotic process automation (RPA) technologies is preferred but not required.
  • Working knowledge of operational rules, regulations, and procedures governing deposit operations, ACH processing, wires, disputes, account maintenance, and transaction processing activities within a financial institution.
  • Excellent problem-solving, organizational, analytical, verbal and written communication skills. Must be able to multi-task.
  • Strong decision making and time management skills with the ability to manage multiple projects/duties.
  • Trustworthy with the ability to maintain highest level of integrity and trust.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office products, specifically Outlook, Word and Excel

Tools & Work Environment

  • Stable internet connection with speeds high enough for video conferencing and screen sharing
  • Smartphone with current iOS/Android OS
  • Prolonged periods sitting at a workstation and working on a computer
  • Ability to communicate with coworkers and customers via email, chat, teleconference, and/or phone

Where You Can Work

This position follows a hybrid work schedule, with three days per week onsite at our corporate office in Purchase, NY.

Quorum's opportunities are based in the U.S., and U.S. work authorization is required. We are not able to provide current or future sponsorship.

Compensation & Rewards

Compensation for this role is $21.00 - $25.00 per hour with the potential for discretionary incentive compensation based on both company and individual performance.

Benefits That Support You

  • Excellent health insurance packages with a Health Reimbursement Account option
  • Life, AD&D, Short-Term Disability and Travel Insurance
  • 401k plan with company match dollar for dollar up to 6 percent*
  • Generous time-off policy with paid time off (PTO), volunteer time off (VTO), birthday PTO, and company-observed holidays
  • Monthly stipend for wellness activities and mental health*

  • Pet Benefits, including insurance, discounts, “pawternity” PTO day, and more
  • Bonus/commission plan for qualifying roles
  • Employee perks (including mortgage discounts!)
  • PTO purchase and sell-back programs
  • Rewards and peer recognition programs
  • Trust-based, out-come oriented remote work environment for most roles

*After 6 months of service

Important Compliance Information

  • Quorum is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status.
  • Quorum will make reasonable accommodations in compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990. Reasonable accommodations are available upon request for applicants and/or employees with qualifying disabilities throughout the application and employment process.
  • Qualified Applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with all applicable federal, state, city and local laws, rules, and regulations.

Employee(s) will be required to follow any other job-related instructions and to perform any other job-related duties requested by any person authorized to give instructions or assignments. The company reserves the sole right and discretion to make changes to this job description.

Position Summary

Are you looking for a rewarding career where you can make a difference every day? Pennington Health Services is seeking a compassionate, energetic, and dependable Activity Aide to join our team.

The Activity Aide plays an important role in enhancing the quality of life of our residents by creating meaningful opportunities for engagement, socialization, recreation, and personal fulfillment. Working alongside our interdisciplinary clinical team, the Activity Aide helps support residents' physical, emotional, social, cognitive, and spiritual well-being through individualized and group activities.

title: Supervisor - 3rd shift
description:
Imagine: A Career with Purpose and Possibility

Picture this: You are part of a global team of problem-solvers whose innovations in materials science can make life better. Every day, you help turn ideas into impact using science, technology, and creativity to tackle real-world challenges. You are part of a company whose work helps improve patient outcomes in healthcare and protects essential consumer goods that people around the world rely on every day.

At TekniPlex, you’ll join more than 8,000 colleagues across 12 countries, all united by one purpose: creating safer, smarter solutions that touch daily life. Here, your ideas count and your work matters. You’ll be encouraged to think boldly, collaborate across cultures, and keep growing every step of the way. You will help protect the integrity of essential products, support patient safety and comfort, and contribute to innovations that make everyday life better, all while building a career that makes an impact.

Because at TekniPlex, you don’t just deliver products – you help shape what’s next.

JOB SUMMARY

TekniPlex is hiring a supervisor-3rd Shift for our South Madison, WI facility. This role is responsible for day-to-day direction of shift team members, health & safety, maintenance, and supporting engineering for the Madison facility. It will have an ongoing focus area will include: Continuous improvement, project management and Lean Management Operating System (MOS) - implementation and sustainment.

A successful candidate will understand and practice Servant Leadership to lead a production team through the manufacturing of materials from raw product to finished product. It also requires an enhanced ability to analyze data for equivalency, trends, and meet specifications while adhering to quality procedures and systems. The salary range for this role is $80,000 to $100,000 annually. Pay is based on experience.

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Directly supervises up to 20 employees in the Production team, with both direct and indirect labor. Approving timecards for hourly staff every payroll cycle. Carries out supervisory responsibilities in accordance with the organization's Safety Philosophy, policies and applicable laws. Responsibilities include interviewing, hiring, and training employees; planning, assigning, and directing work; appraising performance; rewarding and disciplining employees; addressing complaints and resolving problems.
  • Plans and coordinates work, trains, motivates, monitors and evaluates performance of employees; ensures their ability to SAFELY operate equipment to produce product; counsels, records, and disciplines as necessary.
  • Responsible for all processes, equipment, employees’ safety, and housekeeping of the entire operations area and meeting productions quality and quantity standards on the shift.
  • Support the plant to manufacture and deliver quality products to meet customer expectations.
  • Collaborate with members of the supply chain; operations, product management, and customer support teams, to engage and work effectively across all levels of the organization.
  • Facilitate training and development in lean techniques.
  • Active member of Plant Safety Team
  • Initiate actions to prevent any non-conformances related to product, process and systems.
  • Work with operational leadership to ensure appropriate plant KPIs are established.
  • Investigate and understand MUV (Material Usage Variance) for the plant.
  • Work directly with machine operators to identify needs and develop solutions; work with Maintenance on equipment modifications and preventative /predictive maintenance to ensure reliability.
  • Identify, propose and execute projects to improve customer satisfaction, through performance and product reliability. Develops / improves product reliability, performance consistency and cost effectiveness.
  • Provide manufacturing waste, Overall Equipment Effectiveness and other key operational reports to the site leadership team.
  • Ensures Quality products and processes are maintained by:
    • Understanding and supporting both quality policies and the Quality System while assisting with customer quality audits as needed.
    • Performing work at a level that ensures quality of this position meets or exceeds internal and external customer specifications.
    • Identifying and correcting, if possible, any identified quality issues both in the department and plant as a whole.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • At least 3 years in operational roles or equivalent combination of education and experience in a supervisor role within a manufacturing environment.
  • Experience in printing, extrusion, injection molding are a plus.
  • Ability to lead, motivate, select, train and instruct personnel.
  • Good interpersonal, organizational and communication skills are a must.
  • Bilingual in English and Spanish is a Plus
  • Demonstrated Project Management skills are a must.
  • Excellent knowledge and understanding of ERP systems and ERP implementation protocols and procedures.
  • Knowledge of continuous Improvement tools and their application (PDCA, root cause analysis etc.) Excellent problem-solving skills.
  • Outstanding interpersonal and organizational skills and the ability to lead others, coach and model effective teamwork. Ability to plan, organize and handle a variety of tasks and responsibilities simultaneously.
  • Ability to work independently and self-directed. Ability to interface with all levels of management and external community contacts and possess strong relationship management and negotiation skills.
  • Strong ability to influence and work through others to achieve results.
  • Strong computer skills i.e. MS Office, pivot tables, and Share Point.

LANGUAGE SKILLS

Ability to read and interpret documents such as safety rules, operating and maintenance instructions and procedure manuals. Ability to write routine reports and legibly complete time cards and work orders. Ability to read, analyze, and interpret technical procedures and read blueprints and technical drawings, such as machine, mechanical, pneumatic, hydraulic, and electrical. Ability to effectively present information in one-on-one and small groups situations to other employees of the organization. Ability to effective present information and respond to questions form groups of managers, clients, customers, and the general public.

MATHEMATICAL SKILLS

Ability to add, subtract, multiply and divide in all units of measure, using whole numbers, common fractions, and decimals. Ability to compute rate, ratio, and percent. Ability to apply concepts of basic algebra, geometry, fractions, percentages, ratios, and proportions to practical situations.

REASONING ABILITY

Ability to solve practical problems and deal with a variety of variable in situations where only limited standardization exists. Ability to interpret a variety of instructions furnished in written, oral, diagram, or schedule form. Ability to define problems, collect data, establish facts, and draw valid conclusions. Ability to interpret an extensive variety of technical instructions in mathematical or diagram form.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations will be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to stand, walk, and talk or hear. The employee frequently is required to use hands to finger, handle, or feel and reach with hands and arms. The employee is occasionally required to sit; climb or balance; stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl; and taste or smell. The employee must regularly lift and/or move up to 10 pounds, frequently lift and/or move up to 50 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus.

WORK ENVIRONMENT

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is frequently exposed to moving mechanical parts and vibration. The employee is occasionally exposed to high, precarious places; fumes or airborne particles; toxic, flammable or caustic chemicals; outside weather conditions; and extreme heat. The Eindhoven University of Technology (TU/e) is seeking a highly talented, ambitious and passionate PhD candidate to investigate and further develop our model of heart valve preservation. We aim to develop a way to keep heart valves alive outside of the human body using dynamic bioreactors where the valves open and close as they do in the human body. As the successful candidate, your research with us will contribute to broader efforts to culture living cardiac tissues and to study their function and their response to immune cells and immune protective technology, closely aligned with our BIOSHIELD consortium funded by the Dutch Heart Foundation. Our group’s research concentrates on developing and improving heart valve replacements in young children born with congenital heart disease. The current valve replacement options available in clinical practice cannot adapt to the growing heart of a child and can elicit immune responses that destroy and calcify implanted valves. Therefore, these young patients require multiple invasive operations throughout their lives. We investigate how to develop a living valve that can grow with the heart and is safe from immune rejection. Alongside our advances in in-situ tissue engineering of heart valves, we investigate strategies for immune shielding and culture of living human donor heart valves as an alternative approach. An essential step in moving this approach forward is to maintain and preserve heart valves outside the human body. In this project, we will focus on extended culture and preservation of donor valves, unravelling valve homeostatic maintenance, and translating this knowledge into smart culture conditions and bioreactor designs with feedback options. This presents an exciting engineering challenge: designing systems that can reproduce the complex flow conditions, pressures, and mechanical stimuli experienced by heart valves in the human body. By combining mechanical design, fluid dynamics, and biomedical engineering, we aim to develop innovative bioreactor technologies.

You will generate unprecedented experimental data as a pioneer in the field to unravel the conditions for optimal ex vivo cardiovascular tissue preservation. Your investigations will build upon our track record on bioreactor design for tissue-engineered heart valves and in-house expertise with heart perfusion models to build a system that can maintain heart valves viable outside of the human body.

To that end, your research will include a selection of techniques including: i) flow-based bioreactor development, ii) sterile vessel and tissue culture, and iii) sophisticated tissue analysis including advanced microscopy. You are expected to write a doctoral thesis and publish your research results in scientific journals. A small part of your doctoral position will involve teaching in courses as well as the supervision of students at the bachelor’s and master’s levels offered by the group. Also, an educational and professional development program will be offered to you.

You will be embedded in a highly inspiring research environment, both socially and professionally, which facilitates access to high-end research facilities, as well as fosters interdisciplinary collaborations. You will be an integral member of the Soft Tissue Engineering and Mechanobiology (STEM) group of the Department Biomedical Engineering, and specifically operate at the interface of the teams led by Assistant Professor dr Marijn Peters (Translational Engineering for Pediatric Cardiovascular Regeneration) and Professor Carlijn Bouten (Cell-Matrix Interactions for Cardiovascular Regeneration) at the Department of Biomedical Engineering at TU/e. You will also work together with the team of Julie Legrand (Mechanical Engineering) and Assistant Professor Marcel Rutten (Cardiovascular Biomechanics) to build upon their work on Soft Robotics Systems, Biomechanical models, and Vascular Bioreactors.

Your project is aligned with our BIOSHIELD consortium of the Hartstichting: BIOengineering immune Shielded Heart valve Implants: Engineering Living Donor tissue by translating prenatal protection mechanisms from the womb to the heart. In this consortium, we work together with cardiothoracic surgery and transplantation immunology at the University Medical Center Utrecht and the Wilhelmina Children’s Hospital and the ETB-Bislife Multi Tissue Center. We stimulate and foster cross-institutional collaborations as part of the project.

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
About UnlockLand UnlockLand is a Singapore-based AI technology company building decision-making software for land development, urban planning and pre-development. Our platform combines planning policies, land data, development evidence, geospatial technology and AI-powered workflows, helping developers, planners and public-sector organisations assess opportunities and make better decisions. We are looking for a Full-Stack Engineer with hands-on experience in GIS, Three.js and 2D/3D computational geometry. The Role You will build interactive geospatial applications for land analysis, urban planning and development feasibility. Your work will involve 2D maps, 3D scenes, land parcels, buildings, planning controls and geometry-processing workflows. You will work across frontend, backend, spatial databases and cloud infrastructure. You should be able to take a complex geospatial requirement from concept to working product. This role requires real project experience across all three areas: GIS and geospatial data Three.js or comparable web-based 3D technology 2D and 3D geometry processing Key Responsibilities

Build interactive 2D and 3D geospatial web applications. Develop map-based interfaces for land, planning and development workflows. Build and optimise Three.js scenes containing terrain, parcels, buildings and planning data. Implement object selection, highlighting, measurement, editing and layer controls. Develop tools for drawing and editing points, lines, polygons, boundaries and building forms. Implement geometry operations such as intersection, clipping, buffering, offsetting, union and subtraction. Develop triangulation, extrusion, mesh generation and spatial-measurement workflows. Process coordinate systems, projections and geospatial transformations. Work with GeoJSON, vector tiles, raster data, shapefiles and 3D geospatial formats. Design spatial APIs, backend services and data-processing pipelines. Build and optimise spatial database queries using PostgreSQL and PostGIS. Integrate external GIS services, planning datasets and mapping APIs. Improve rendering performance for large geospatial and 3D datasets. Develop customer POCs and convert successful prototypes into production features. Work with urban planners, product designers and customers to understand professional workflows. Translate planning and development requirements into reliable technical solutions. Test, deploy, monitor and maintain production systems. Use AI-assisted development tools while remaining responsible for architecture and code quality. Requirements

At least 3 years of relevant software engineering experience. Demonstrated experience building GIS or web-mapping applications. Strong hands-on experience with Three.js. Experience developing interactive 3D scenes for production applications. Strong understanding of 2D and 3D geometry. Experience implementing computational geometry operations. Work on technically challenging GIS and 3D problems. Build products used for real land-development and urban-planning decisions. Work directly with planners, designers, customers and product teams. title: BAS Systems Specialist I
description:
Work hard, have fun! At Cerris Systems, we believe in delivering quality craftsmanship while having fun along the way. Our group of construction companies prides itself on our almost 100-year history, our employee ownership structure, and our competitive pay and benefits. From the moment you start working with us, we’ve got your growth in mind. We believe Cerris isn’t just a great place to start your career – it’s a great place to watch it advance for years to come.

Come build the extraordinary with us. Apply today!

Nature of Work

Serves Customers by servicing controls systems and products. Sets up, commissions, and services low voltage HVAC Direct Digital Control (DDC) systems on commercial and industrial buildings.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

    • Provide Controls database, graphics, programming, etc. for sequences as provided by the Engineering team, project specifications, or other applicable sources.
    • Provide accurate controls start-up and commissioning including point-to-point checkout on projects as assigned. Verify correct alarm, annunciation, and other actions by equipment, devices, panels, and annunciators of controls projects.
    • Support installation personnel on project sites.
    • Provide information and support for other contractors on project site.
    • Debug installation issues during both the static and dynamic start up and commissioning of building controls.
    • Provide support to coworkers and other contractors to solve building operating issues that go beyond the controls or special systems operation.
    • Provide input to others, as requested or required, to assist in the accurate estimation, design, installation, start up, commissioning, and training for building systems.
    • Provide mentoring and direct day-to-day supervision to level I positions while consistently achieving all objectives of this position.
    • Provide start up documentation including daily logs, check out logs, commissioning documents, etc. as required for assigned projects.
    • Ensure timely software backups are created for projects and software development.
    • Provide service support on existing installations ensuring systems continue to meet existing building occupancy codes.
    • Provide service support on existing systems ensuring their proper and efficient operation as well as providing ongoing support to the facility’s building engineers.
    • Complete time sheets, service work orders, and other paperwork required for this position in an accurate and timely manner.
    • Assist in preparing of submittal documents, As-built drawings and operation & maintenance manuals.
    • Assist in turnover of projects from Operations Team to Service Team.
    • Assist Sales team during estimating phase including potential product or system demonstrations.
    • Travel to jobs within service area and work with dispatch to ensure schedule is maintained and delays are promptly communicated.
    • Tie workflow to schedule.
    • Produce timely and detailed service reports.
    • Maintain a satisfactory driving record which, per Company’s vehicle policy, allows operation of a vehicle for business purposes.
    • Comprehend customer requirements and make appropriate recommendations/briefings
    • Build positive relationships with customers.
    • Exercise initiative or, as directed, perform additional duties to meet the needs of the organization.

    Qualifications

    • Ability to perform work accurately and completely, and in a timely manner
    • Ability to work independently with little to no supervision
    • A clear ability to work with electrical equipment such as volt meters, amp meters, etc.
    • The ability to troubleshoot basic electric circuitry including reading and interpreting electrical, control, and special system diagrams
    • A working understanding of low and high voltage AC circuitry including transformers, fuses, breakers, multi-phase power, etc.
    • An understanding of the construction industry including safety, electrical codes, etc.
    • Knowledge in one or all of the following building control systems - Tridium, Honeywell Spyder, Alerton, and Distech
    • The ability to configure and debug computer and networking problems
    • Experience with programming
    • An ability to understand empathetically the issues and perceptions others have and to creatively and successfully work through these issues to achieve a successful outcome and customer and employee satisfaction
    • A thorough understanding of HVAC operations within a facility if working in the controls field
    • Excellent customer service skills
    • Ability to understand and implement best practice standards
    • Ability to quickly and effectively solve complex problems
    • Ability to deliver quality through attention to detail
    • Organizational skills
    • Listening skills
    • Ability to adapt to change and stress in the work environment and manage competing demands while maintaining high performance levels
    • Ability to be proactive and resourceful
    • Ability to follow-up on inquiries in a timely manner
    • Ability to prioritize multiple projects
    • Proficiency in all company utilized software including Microsoft Office Suite
    • Ability to build relationships with team members that transcend a project
    • Ability to build relationships and collaborate within a team, internally and externally

    Education

    • Minimum of high school diploma or GED
    • Two-year technical degree or qualified apprenticeship program in HVAC or Electronics related studies preferred. An undergraduate degree in Electrical or Mechanical related studies is excellent

    Experience

    • 2+ years of low voltage installation in controls or special systems preferred.
    • Other work-related experience such as military, on the job training programs, etc. may meet this requirement as determined by local management.

    Physical Demands and Working Environment

    • Able to lift and carry ladders, drawings, personal computers, material, etc.
    • Able to lift up to 50lbs.
    • Able to spend significant time standing and walking on construction sites.
    • Able to climb several flights of stairs or ladders throughout a typical day on a construction site.
    • Be physically able to kneel, stoop and crawl.

title: Consultant Prosthodontist – Dubai /Tax-Free Income/ Premium Hospitals

This opportunity is designed for board-certified prosthodontists seeking career advancement, exposure to complex restorative cases, and the opportunity to practice within a JCI-accredited / premium dental setting.

Role Overview

• Position: Consultant / Specialist Prosthodontist
• Location: Dubai, United Arab Emirates
• Facility Type: Private dental hospital / multispecialty dental center / tertiary care setup
• Experience Required: Minimum 3+ years post specialist or board certification

We are a global leader in the design, manufacture, and distribution of ophthalmic lenses, frames, and sunglasses. We offer our industry stakeholders in over 150 countries access to a global platform of high-quality vision care products such as the Essilor brand, with Varilux, Crizal, Eyezen, Stellest and Transitions, iconic brands that consumers love such as Ray-Ban, Oakley, Persol and Oliver Peoples, as well as a network that offers consumers high-quality vision care and best-in-class shopping experiences such as Sunglass Hut, LensCrafters, and Target Optical, and leading e-commerce platforms.

In our dynamic environment, fueled by technology and innovation, our people have the space to pioneer new solutions.

Join our global community of over 200,000 dedicated employees around the world in driving the transformation of the eyewear and eyecare industry. Discover more by following us on LinkedIn!

JOB DESCRIPTION

GENERAL FUNCTION

The Production Supervisor evaluates work processes to determine strategies and programs which provide greater productivity and efficiency of company functions.

MAJOR DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Gathers information to evaluate current work processes in order to determine the flow of work, time requirements, costs, and duration.
  • Develops strategies and programs that improve the productivity and efficiency of the various work processes of the company.
  • Applies various industrial engineering problem solving and productivity techniques to evaluate the improvement of recommended strategies and programs.
  • Provides technical support for the qualification and validation of new product introductions to ensure all aspects of performance, manufacturability and quality are achieved.
  • Provides technical support for the qualification and validation of new equipment and processes; and identifies and implements new technologies to continuously improve processes.
  • Instructs and leads others in continuous process improvements, including the use of various problem solving and productivity techniques such as process mapping and cost time management.
  • Develops and coordinates programs to recognize and reward groups or individuals for suggestions and actions related to process improvement.
  • Leads and supports root cause analysis investigations, recommends and executes corrective actions and preventative actions.
  • Develops and facilitates employee teams to build cohesiveness and improve the overall results of the respective teams' tasks.

title: Embedded Software Engineer
description:
SHAPING THE FUTURE THROUGH INNOVATION AND DISCOVERY!

With a history spanning more than seven decades, Communications & Power Industries’ thousands of products have impacted people’s lives in numerous unseen ways every day. Our highly engineered products serve as the backbone of modern-day commercial and military communications systems, assist in diagnosing medical conditions, empower scientific discoveries and space exploration, and much more.

CPI is headquartered in Plano, Texas and is a global manufacturer of electronic components and subsystems. We have manufacturing locations in the United States, Canada, Europe, and Asia. With a heritage of technological excellence, our team serves customers in the communications, defense, medical, industrial, and scientific markets.

YOUR DAY TO DAY:

Reporting to the Software Engineering Manager, you will work in the R&D group to develop and maintain embedded software for use in medical X-Ray Generators. The Embedded Software Engineer must be proficient with C++.

YOU WILL BE ACCOUNTABLE TO:

  • Design, develop, and test embedded object orientated software for medical x-ray generators.
  • Optimize system performance, stability and scalability.
  • Collaborate with hardware and software teams to define software specifications and ensure seamless integration
  • Debug and troubleshoot issues across software and hardware domains.
  • Develop and maintain detailed documentation, including requirements and design specifications.
  • Interface with cross functional teams, customers, and end users.
  • Stay current with industry trends and emerging technologies in embedded systems.

YOU ARE THE RIGHT PERSON FOR THIS JOB IF YOU HAVE:

  • University Technical Degree
  • Minimum 5 years’ work experience in:
    • Embedded C++ programming
    • Microcontrollers
    • Real-Time OS
    • Multi-Threading
  • Excellent organizational, interpersonal, oral, and written communication skills

POSITION ASSETS:

  • Experience in designing and troubleshooting of hard real-time control systems.
  • Experience in RS232, CAN Bus, I2C, SPI and Ethernet communications, ADC and DAC.
  • Ability to understand electrical schematics, understanding of basic electrical principals such as induction, capacitance, three-phase current etc.
  • Ability to use Logic Analyser and Oscilloscope.
  • Low-Level Device Drivers (Linux)
  • Experience with Embedded Web Server, JavaScript, CSS, HTML and PHP programming.
  • Ability to travel internationally - ~5%

Whether you are a seasoned professional or just embarking on your career, CPI is an ideal place to expand your knowledge and expertise. CPI is committed to providing equal employment opportunities for all current and prospective employees, as well as to promoting a culture of inclusion and respect for everyone. description:

General Purpose of Job

The primary responsibility of the Architectural Services Representative [ASR] is to place the proper Dunn-Edwards products and colors in architectural and engineering master specifications as exclusively as possible. The ASR will establish and maintain good working relationships with all architects, engineers, specification writers and design professionals in his/her territory and demonstrate to those customers our desire to provide the highest level of professional services available. The ASR will also employ product and market expertise to partner with Sales colleagues to win key projects.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

The Architectural Services Representative is part of the Dunn-Edwards sales team and, as such, must always keep in mind the objective of selling the job. Proper job specifications will not only serve the architect and his client, the owner, but also must be written to ensure our chance of securing the job through the painting contractor. When requested by customers, the ASR will participate in job walks and write specifications for specific projects. When requested by customers, the ASR will provide crossover specifications and review submittals. ASR’s also prepare and present “Lunch Box” and other types of seminars - frequency and content to be established with Management. ASRs are product experts and provide Outside Sales and Stores team members practical surface/system recommendations.

The Construction Specification Institute (CSI) is an important link to our customer base. The ASR must join and participate in a local chapter including monthly meetings and trade shows.

ASR’s are accountable for growth in their assigned territory and will be called upon to partner with and sometimes lead sales teams that pursue key projects. Reflect a positive attitude; be enthusiastic, friendly and professional. Demonstrate a strong desire to succeed. Be known as a self-starter, energetic and motivated.

Supervisory Responsibilities: There are no subordinate supervisors reporting to this position. There are no other non-supervisory employees who report directly to this job.

Education and/or Experience: Bachelors degree, one to three years related experience and/or training; or equivalent combination of education and experience. The ASR position demands a working knowledge of reading architectural plans (blueprints) within 90 days of accepting the position.

Language Skills: For safety reasons, ability to read, write, and communicate in English is required. Ability to read, analyze, and interpret general business periodicals, professional journals, technical procedures, or government regulations; ability to write reports, business correspondence, and procedure manuals; ability to effectively present information and respond to questions from groups of managers, clients, customers and the general public..

Mathematical Skills: Ability to calculate figures and amounts such as discounts, interest, commissions, percentages, and profitability; ability to apply concepts of basic algebra and geometry.

Reasoning Ability: Ability to solve practical problems and deal with a variety of concrete variables in situations where only limited standardization exists; ability to interpret a variety of instructions furnished in written, oral, diagrammatic, or schedule form; ability to define problems, collect data, establish facts, and draw valid conclusions.

Certificates, Licenses, Registrations: Certifications or designations are recognized by architects and signify a commitment to professionalism in representing Dunn-Edwards. Attaining CDT, LEED and other achievements are encouraged and may become a part of a development plan.

Additional Information: Good project management skills; good organization and time management skills; good oral and written communication skills; must be able to travel 25% of the time including global travel; good working knowledge of MS Office applications.

Store and Outside Sales: Store and Outside Sales positions may have physical requirements that include, but are not limited to: (1) Lifting of items, such as sundries or containers of paint weighting from 5 to 75 pounds (2) Use of electronic equipment including, but not limited to computers, point of sale devices, communication devices (3) Driving a large delivery truck/vehicle (4) Climbing ladders (5) Walking on uneven surfaces, e.g., active construction sites (6) Interactions with customers, both face-to-face and on the telephone (7) Interaction with customers relating to color (8) Standing for long periods of time (9) Use of a respirator

location: Washington, District of Columbia, United States
description:
About Peregrine

Peregrine Advisors is a rapidly growing AI and data innovation hub helping government solve hard problems and deliver better outcomes. We work across the full lifecycle—from strategy and governance through architecture, engineering, analytics, AI, visualization, and training—for clients including the SEC, PCAOB, DDOT, and DCAA.

Our clients describe our support as “absolutely excellent” and our people as “instrumental to organization’s success.” Winner of the United Nations COP27 Datathon, our work has earned all Exceptional CPARS ratings, SEC Chair’s Awards, the SEC Vision Award, and recognition from FDA leadership.

We are also built differently. Peregrine is the first and only social enterprise organized as a Benefit Corporation and SBA 8(a) company focused on AI and data for government. We believe business success should create client value, social value, and opportunity for our people.

As we enter our next stage of growth, we need dependable, motivated, and skilled people who have a combination of intellectual curiosity and intellectual courage. With new clients, larger programs, and expanding responsibilities, the people joining Peregrine now will have the opportunity to help shape the company we become.

People first. Ownership always.

We solve problems through people, process, and technology—in that order. Technology matters, but people make transformation happen. That principle defines our culture. Trust and motivation are the foundational pillars of delivery on which our skills stand. We hire people we can trust, who care deeply about what they do, take ownership, learn quickly, help one another, and refuse to walk past a problem because it belongs to someone else.

At Peregrine, you are not joining simply to fill a position. You are joining a team, taking ownership of a mission, and helping build a company. If that excites you, we should talk.

Your work at Peregrine Advisors will cover both development and support for cloud-native Python services running on Amazon Web Services (AWS). But we hire people, not seats. As the work evolves, you will move to where the hardest problems are.

This is a hybrid work arrangement based in the Washington, DC metropolitan area, and the commuting cadence varies by assignment. The initial engagement requires United States citizenship and the ability to obtain a Public Trust determination.

Your first project

On your first project, you will likely see user stories through every stage, from refinement to production. Depending on the assignment, you may:

  • Turn user stories into back-end features written in Python on a cloud-native AWS stack.
  • Create the React.js screens and components through which users reach those features.
  • Connect internal systems to commercial products by creating the integrations and application programming interfaces (APIs) between them.
  • Rely on Amazon Simple Storage Service (S3), AWS Lambda, and related AWS services to automate workflows.
  • Contribute to automating the continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipeline, produce secure, accessible code, and provide production support for your services.
  • Write tests at both the unit and integration levels, take part in code reviews, and fix the defects you uncover as you carry the work through to production.
  • Support quality development practices, with test-driven development and automated testing among them.
  • Make AI-assisted development tools part of your daily routine, reviewing and testing all of their output.

You take responsibility for delivering tested, working code, carrying it through production and finding and fixing its defects. Your automation replaces the spreadsheet workflows, manual checks, and validations in business operations, and you create deployment pipelines that make service releases routine.

This is where you start, not the shape of your career here.

Requirements

  • 4+ years of professional hands-on software development experience, with back-end work in Python and front-end work in React.js
  • Bachelor's degree
  • Familiarity with development in the AWS cloud and with services including Amazon S3 and AWS Lambda
  • Skill in applying data modeling, design patterns, and object-oriented design to turn a defined specification into tested code that works, then owning that code through production
  • A background working with relational database systems such as SQL Server, PostgreSQL, or Oracle
  • A background using NoSQL databases, for example DynamoDB or MongoDB
  • Sound analytical judgment, applied through strong problem-solving and troubleshooting skills
  • A history of Agile delivery, whether Scrum, Kanban, or similar, with work tracked in Jira or a comparable tool
  • The ability to communicate exceptionally well, collaborate directly with non-technical stakeholders at the client, and translate requirements from the business into technical solutions
  • Reliable estimates for the tasks assigned to you and the effort they take
  • Proficiency in writing, PowerPoint, and Excel

Preferred

  • Familiarity with the practices used in DevSecOps and with CI/CD pipelines
  • Hands-on experience delivering production workloads in AWS, or certification in Python or AWS
  • Experience providing consulting services while interacting with clients
  • Prior work in information technology for the federal government
  • Familiarity with tools that use AI to help developers

Who you are

You care about your work and assess it by how well it serves those who depend on it. You adapt when priorities change and develop enough depth in new tools or domains to make your own judgments instead of relying on instructions. You experiment, fail, learn, and repeat quickly. You would rather own an outcome than be handed a task.

What you bring

  • Hands-on fluency in modern cloud development, with the breadth to improve a system already in place or to create something new.
  • Delivery habits that cover secure coding, accessibility, code review, unit and integration testing, and version control.
  • Plain, clear communication with everyone who relies on your work, and an ear for what they actually need.
  • A meticulous streak wherever accuracy and auditability cannot be compromised.

You adapt your development workflow as AI tools evolve, using them to help implement, test, and improve the components you own. You give the tools clear context, review and test their output, and remain accountable for the code you deliver.

When we talk

Be prepared to discuss a difficult problem you worked through, the decisions you made, what happened, and what you learned.

Benefits

This is a full-time W-2 position with a salary of $120,000 to $150,000 per year.

Benefits include medical, dental, and vision insurance with the employee premium fully paid and half of dependent premiums; employer-paid life, accidental death, and short-term and long-term disability insurance; a 401(k) with an employer match of up to 4% of salary; unlimited paid time off; and sponsored professional certifications and continuing education.

What we offer

You will work alongside developers, engineers, data scientists, architects, and strategists, on work ranging from strategy to implementation. We support your development across assignments and clients through extensive onboarding, sponsored professional certifications such as the Data Management Capability Assessment Model (DCAM) and AWS technical certifications, and rotation across functions to expand your skills and perspective. The mission is real, the problems are hard, and you own what you ship.

What we commit to

As a Benefit Corporation, our commitment runs three ways: real, measurable value for our clients; government that works better for the public; and a team that makes everyone in it better.

We hire people who want to help build the firm, not just work at it. If that is you, apply.

Peregrine Advisors is an equal opportunity employer.

Build the Future of Football in Barcelona

What if your passion for football could become something you lead, grow, and make your own?

Stranger Soccer is expanding into new cities around the world and is looking for a License Owner / Operator to bring the Stranger Soccer experience to Barcelona.

This isn't a traditional management position. It's an opportunity to build, own, and grow a local football operation while becoming part of an established international brand. We're looking for entrepreneurial individuals who are passionate about football and driven to create a meaningful impact in their local community.

Imagine Being the Person Who...

● Brings football players together through a seamless mobile platform

● Builds a vibrant football community in Barcelona

● Creates memorable playing experiences week after week

● Leads a growing local operation backed by proven technology and global expertise

What You'll Do

As the License Owner / Operator, you'll oversee every aspect of Stranger Soccer, including:

● Growing the local player community

● Securing football venues and partnerships

● Recruiting and managing Official Hosts

● Leading marketing and community-building initiatives

● Delivering consistently outstanding game experiences

You'll have the independence to grow your local operation while receiving ongoing support, technology, and operational guidance from our Singapore headquarters.

Why Stranger Soccer?

Stranger Soccer makes playing football as simple as booking a gym session. Through our mobile app, players can discover games, reserve a spot, and simply turn up to play.

Founded in Singapore, Stranger Soccer now operates in 10+ cities worldwide and has delivered more than 100,000 games. Our proven model is built for growth—and we're ready to bring it to Barcelona.

Who We're Looking For

● A football enthusiast with strong local insight

● An entrepreneurial self-starter who enjoys taking ownership

● A leader who can build relationships and grow a local community

● Someone looking for more than a job—someone who wants to create lasting impact

Ready to Take the Lead?

Visit and explore "Bring Stranger Soccer to Your City" to learn more and express your interest.

Help shape the future of football in Barcelona—and build something you'll be proud of.

title: Board Operator - Vest Plant - Kermit, TX (West Texas)
description:
Company Overview
Iron Oak Energy, a leading provider of proppant to the oil and gas industry with a differentiated footprint of low-cost, logistically advantaged mining and terminal assets serving all major U.S. shale basins. Iron Oak Energy Solutions, formed from the strategic combination of Covia Energy and Black Mountain Sand to create a premier frac sand mining company, delivering superior products and solutions to diversified oil and natural gas markets across North America. The combination positions Iron Oak Energy with unmatched scale, reliability, and deliverability to customers in all major oil and gas shale plays.

The Board Operator position requires an understanding of all equipment, job duties, and personnel involved in maintaining product flow through the plant. The position is primarily responsible for the operation of the on-board computer and equipment automation systems and requires familiarity with the hands-on operation of plant equipment. This position will be expected to adhere to all safety regulations and practice safe operations at all times.

Essential Functions

  • Completes pre-shift inspections and JSA’s, and interfaces with relief operator for any updates, instructions, and changes.
  • Controls product flow through the plant equipment via automation computer systems for decant belt and gate operation, conveyors, surge bins, dryers, screens, bucket elevators, dust collectors and other process equipment; reports any malfunctioning equipment to supervisor.
  • Monitors aggregate flow through the plant, recording and reporting temperatures, moisture levels, and processing rates and adjusting as necessary to meet production specifications.
  • Anticipates and troubleshoots significant changes in equipment function, and production rate; elevates to management as appropriate.
  • Communicates with supervisor, fellow board operator, lead, and operators to ensure safe and efficient plant operation.


Required Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Sufficient education to operate relevant computer software and complete written documentation and records; or an equivalent combination of experience, education and training that provides the desired knowledge, skills, and characteristics.
  • Must have basic computer skills.
  • Must have Basic maintenance skills sufficient to inspect equipment and complete minor repairs as required.
  • Previous sand plant or oilfield experience is preferred.
  • Must have effective communication skills; ability to speak and write.
  • Must have team player attitude with high-level of self-motivation requiring minimal supervision.
  • Must be willing to work any shift, overtime, weekends, and holidays as nature of plant schedule may fluctuate.
  • Must be authorized to work in the US and be at least 18 years of age.
  • Must have and maintain a valid driver’s license
  • Must be able to wear a respirator and other required personal protective equipment

Job Benefits

Iron Oak Energy offers a comprehensive and competitive compensation package for candidates when they join our team. Benefits enjoyed by members of our team include:

  • Competitive wage
  • Health, dental, vision and long-term disability insurance following 60-days of employment
  • 401(K) retirement savings plan
  • Paid holidays and time off

title: Ultrasound Technologist
description:
Envision Imaging is adding an Ultrasound Technologist to the team!
Monday, Tuesday, Thursday, Friday 7:00 AM - 6:00 PM | Position Pay Range $40.75 - $52.54

Summary/Objective:

Performs ultrasound procedures to adult and pediatric patients for diagnosis and/or treatment of anatomic and physiologic disorders. Assists radiologists during specialized exams to obtain images at a satisfactory level with minimal supervision.

Essential Functions

1. Interfaces with patient to ascertain medical history and provides instructions and explanation of the procedure and/or exam to obtain the best possible image.

2. Reviews patient charts for missed clinical information and/or consent. Screens patients for surgical and other implants, contrast allergies, etc.

3. Performs ultrasound scans and prints images while attending to patient’s care before, during and following exam and notifies the appropriate party if patient’s condition changes at any time.

4. Assists Radiologist on specialized exams.

5. Transfers images to other locations as needed.

6. Coordinates scan protocols with Radiologist.

7. Maintains and regularly inspects equipment and immediately reports any quality concerns as well as equipment failures or deficiencies.

8. Interfaces with Lead Technologist & Center/Area Manager regarding any and all departmental concerns.

9. Other duties as assigned.

Competencies

1. Technical Capacity.

2. Ethical Conduct.

3. Thoroughness.

4. Time Management.

5. Personal Effectiveness/Credibility.

Supervisory Responsibilities

This position has no supervision responsibilities.

Work Environment

This job operates in an environmentally controlled outpatient clinical environment. Potential exposure to radiation, which is minimized by the use of Personal Protective Equipment. Possible exposure to bodily fluids, communicable diseases, toxic substances, ionizing radiation and other conditions common to a medical office environment. Often requires work in cool, dimly lighted rooms.

Physical Demands

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by and employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee may exert up to 50 pounds of force occasionally, and/or up to 30 pounds of force frequently, and/or up to 10 pounds of force constantly to move objects. The employee is regularly required to use hands and fingers to handle, feel or operate objects, tools or controls and reach with hands and arms. The employee is frequently required to talk and hear. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision and the ability to adjust focus.

Travel

No travel is expected for this position.

Job Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications/Experience:

  • Two plus years’ experience in Ultrasound – preferred
  • Ability to educate patients on procedures being performed
  • Detail oriented, self-motivated, a problem solver and a team player
  • Ability to navigate multiple computer screens and browsers quickly and accurately
  • Ability to excel in a very fast-pace team environment
  • Ability to continuously “exceed” company and customer expectation
  • Strong communication skills & professional demeanor

Education/Certifications:

  • Graduate of an accredited Sonography program
  • Current ARDMS Registered Vascular Technologist (RVT) or ARRT (VS) registry – preferred
  • Current ARDMS Registered Obstetrician/Gynecology Technologist (OB/GYN) or ARRT (S) registry - preferred
  • Current license from state medical board (if applicable)
  • Current CPR/BLS certification

Additional Eligibility Qualifications

None required for this position.

Compliance

Adheres to Envision’s Code of Conduct and Compliance Policies and attends annual Compliance training as set forth by the Company.

Company Benefits

Below is a list of benefits that are offered to employees, once eligibility is met.

  • Health Benefits: Medical/Dental/Vision/Life Insurance
  • Company Matched 401k Plan
  • Employee Stock Ownership Plan
  • Paid Time Off + Paid Holidays
  • Employee Assistance Program

Other Duties

Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities and activities may change at any time with or without notice. Other duties may be assigned as needed by supervisor.

OSHA Exposure Rating: 3

It is reasonably anticipated ALL employees in this job classification will have occupational exposure to blood and other potentially infectious body fluids.

We recruit, employ, train, compensate and promote without regard to race, religion, creed, color, national origin, age, gender, sexual orientation, marital status, disability, veteran status, or any other basis protected by application federal, state or local law.

title: Technician
description:
SHAPING THE FUTURE THROUGH INNOVATION AND DISCOVERY!

With a history spanning more than seven decades, Communications & Power Industries’ thousands of products have impacted people’s lives in numerous unseen ways every day. Our highly engineered products serve as the backbone of modern-day commercial and military communications systems, assist in diagnosing medical conditions, empower scientific discoveries and space exploration, and much more.

CPI is headquartered in Plano, Texas and is a global manufacturer of electronic components and subsystems. We have manufacturing locations in the United States, Canada, Europe, and Asia. With a heritage of technological excellence, our team serves customers in the communications, defense, medical, industrial, and scientific markets.

CPI is looking for a skilled and hands-on Technician to join our manufacturing team. In this role, you’ll build, test, troubleshoot, and rework complex electro-mechanical assemblies while helping ensure our products meet demanding quality and performance standards. We’re looking for someone with strong electrical and mechanical aptitude, a keen eye for detail, and pride in their workmanship. If you enjoy solving technical problems, working with advanced electronics, and collaborating in a fast-paced, high-tech manufacturing environment, this is an opportunity to make a direct impact on the quality and delivery of CPI products.

YOU WILL BE ACCOUNTABLE FOR:

Core Responsibilities
• Build, tune, test, and rework electro mechanical assemblies to a high standard of quality, following all technical drawings, specifications, and standard operating procedures.
• Perform functional and performance testing of assemblies using approved test procedures.
• Interpret assembly, electrical, and mechanical drawings to execute build and test activities accurately.
• Support root cause failure analysis on new builds and field returned products in collaboration with Manufacturing Engineering and the Program Management Office.
• Contribute to workstation organization and maintenance, including 5S practices and “clean as you go” standards.
• Support factory station upkeep and actively promote safe working practices across all operations.
• Meet production timelines and support on time delivery of products.

YOU ARE THE RIGHT PERSON FOR THIS JOB IF YOU HAVE:
Technical Skills & Expertise
• Proficient with RF and electronic test equipment, including spectrum analyzers, signal generators, oscilloscopes, and vector signal analyzers, considered an asset.
• Strong mechanical and electrical skills with the ability to build, inspect, and troubleshoot assemblies.
• Capable of diagnosing analog and digital circuitry down to the component level.
• Able to understand and apply technical instructions, inspection criteria, and safety processes.
• Demonstrated ability to create, review, and improve product and process documentation.
• Experience with RF measurements and testing is considered an asset.
________________________________________
Education & Certifications
• Community College Graduate from a three year Electronics Engineering Technologist program, or equivalent education.
• Minimum of 3 years of relevant hands on industry experience.
• IPC J STD 001 certification is required.
________________________________________
Workplace Competencies
• Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate across departments.
• Highly adaptable with the ability to learn quickly and pivot to evolving production requirements.
• Able to work effectively both independently and as part of a team.
• Demonstrated pride in workmanship and commitment to delivering high quality product output.
• Ability to cross train and support other team members when required.
• Ability to operate effectively in a fast paced, high tech manufacturing environment.
• Solution oriented mindset with proactive problem-solving capabilities.

WHO WE ARE:

We value the unique and diverse skills, qualities, and backgrounds that each employee brings to CPI, and we respect each employee as an integral member of our growing team. CPI is committed to providing equal employment opportunities for all current and prospective employees, as well as to promoting a culture of inclusion and respect for everyone. We celebrate the innovation that diversity creates in the work environment, and we recognize that each employee brings their own unique capabilities, experiences, and perspectives to the organization. It is this variety that adds value to our teams, as well as to our stakeholders. We welcome and encourage applicants to reach their full potential with us.

CPI is proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, sexual stereotypes, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

WHAT WE OFFER:

Whether you are a seasoned professional or just embarking on your career, CPI is an ideal place to expand your knowledge and expertise. We cultivate a healthy, dynamic, and team-oriented environment that empowers our employees to develop, create and deliver innovative, reliable technology solutions to power, connect, protect, and support a better tomorrow.
